faqs.question: Is entrance exam required for admission at Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing considers entrance exam scores for admission. faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing?

Steps for EMPI Business School Admission Process 2025

EMPI Business School PGDM admission is entrance-based. Candidates need to first register for the preferred course to participate in the selection rounds. Below are the steps to get a seat in the institute:
Step 1: EMPI Business School Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply online or offline for the preferred course. Aspirants need to pay INR 1,000 for the prospectus and application form available on the campus. Candidates can also pay the application fee of INR 750 via any of the online payment modes.
Step 2: Selection

EMPI Business School selects candidates for the PGDM course based on entrance exam scores. Shortlisted candidates are called for a Group Discussion and Personal Interview round for further selection. The institute also gives weightage to past academic achievements and work experience respectively, apart from the above-mentioned parameters. Applicants are tested through EMPI’s internationally validated Psychometric Profile testing scores in CAT, MAT, XAT, GMAT, CMAT, ATMA as pre-qualifiers for selection.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Results are communicated with selected students who must confirm their seats by paying theEMPI Business School feewithin the specified time frame.

hostel_campus.college_name: EMPI Business School Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: EMPI has separate hostels for girls and boys, which houses more than 700 students from not only different corners of the country but also from various countries. Each room is provided with an attached bathroom with geysers. Both the hostels are also wi-fi enabled and have separate common rooms, which have a TV with cable connection and facility for various indoor games so that students can relax and take their minds off from their hectic schedules during their free periods or during holidays. The fully residential where-in all the students and majority of the faculty live on the campus with 24×7 power and water supply facilities. To get the uninterrupted power supply, 390 KVM electric generators are in use.

sports.description: Available Facilities: Lawn Tennis, Table Tennis, Badminton, Volleyball, Football

cafeteria.description: The EMPI Mess, better known as the Executive Dining Hall provides the best substitute for homemade food. It can accommodate about 200 students at one particular time. The menu comprises of Chinese, South Indian, North Indian, Continental and special dishes during festivals.

reviews.review_heading: Insights on EMPI Business School.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like a gym, Wi-Fi, canteen, lab, library, and classrooms with projectors are available in the college. The whole college is covered with Wi-Fi. There is also the Atal Incubation Centre (AIC LAB). The hostel facility is average and has options like AC/non-AC, and single-double-triple occupancy.

reviews.review_heading: Shivanshu Pandey, Batch - 2023-25.
reviews.review_text:
The college is well equipped with the necessary facilities needed for academics. The classes have AC's and projectors. There is a library, too. We have a computer lab in partnership with IBM. 
Talking about the hostel, The college has a separate hostel on campus for both boys and girls. The college also has the facility to play both outdoor and indoor games so that students can have fun. The food is decent.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at EMPI Business School.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. We have Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, a library, and labs. Talking about the facilities provided by our hostel: Wi-Fi is available, the food is fine, there's power backup in case of outages, AC and cooler units, water coolers with RO purifiers, and a common room. Campus life is awesome.

reviews.review_heading: An institution where one can enhance their personality in both personal and professional manners.
reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure, including free Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and many more amenities. Talking about the hostel, it has a very minimal fee, which includes food and other amenities. The hostel rooms are decent, and cleanliness is always maintained. The food in the hostel is decent.

reviews.review_heading: A hub of learning and global exposure.
reviews.review_text: EMPI'S curriculum is industry-focused with experienced faculty, making learning engaging and practical. The use of case studies and live projects ensures that students are well-prepared for real-world challenges. The hostel is okayish. Mess Food is fine. Provides 3-time meals and snacks.

reviews.review_heading: Inside EMPI: academic excellence and social buzz.
reviews.review_text:
College infrastructure:
Wi-Fi – high-speed internet; labs – well-equipped for practical learning; classrooms – modern with AI aids and library, and for HR students, an HR lab.
Hostel facilities include:
Quality rooms, food, medical, and sports for the students to engage in extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: Journey - Comfort Zone to Corporate via EMPI Business School .
reviews.review_text: The college located in Ansal Vilas, Satbari which is full of greenery. It is a part of Delhi where it feels like living close to the nature. The infrastructure at EMPI is designed to support both learning and leisure. Modern, air-conditioned classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors, while the fully stocked library offers quiet study space. The campus houses a well-appointed computer lab with high-speed internet, essential for research and group projects. The environment is very e...

reviews.review_heading: About EMPI Business School.
reviews.review_text: At the time of my joining EMPI, I was very excited and was ready to grab the opportunity to improve myself and gain as much knowledge as possible. We have a library filled with knowledge, an Atal Incubation Centre where any student with any idea gets help to launch that idea in the market, and labs available according to your convenience. The food in the mess is also delicious, and we are offered different meals every single day.

reviews.review_heading: There are better opportunities to survive in the practical world with the help of EMPI.
reviews.review_text: The hostel availability is so good that a student from any state can stay with the amenities provided by the hostel, which is properly clean and maintained. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and students can have their lunch properly according to timings, with no low quality provided.

reviews.review_heading: A campus of inclusivity, innovation and 100% placement success.
reviews.review_text: I am delighted to share my experience at this college, especially within the real world of finance, where the faculty has truly surpassed expectations. The instructors not only possess remarkable expertise but also tailor their teaching methodologies to meet the specific demands of interviews in the field. Their approach to education is not only enlightening but also aids in comprehending the underlying logic behind complex financial concepts. Beyond academics, the college provides an excellent ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of EMPI Business School.
reviews.review_text: The college provides all the facilities such as Wi-Fi, they have a well-established huge library for students a green and clean infrastructure. The hostel facility is good with high security for all the students. The students have the facility to play sports, do gymming, and much more.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best PGDM college for entrepreneurship.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is built in a huge area. Our college has an AI lab, gym, modern classrooms, amazing greenery, playing area, conference room and many more. There is also a quiet environment for students, which helps them to concentrate on their studies and helps them to enhance their skills. The quality of food served in the canteen is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best PGDM college in Delhi in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: EMPI is the only college in Delhi that has Atal Incubation Centre and IBM labs. For 120 students, the infrastructure is very big. Different games are played on the campus. EMPI has an amphitheater and a gym for students. EMPI offers a residential campus to its students. The food here is very delicious and pocket-friendly.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good if you can manage to get placed on your own or choose a specialisation wisely.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is good. I was a day scholar, so I did not face much problem. The classrooms are good. There are a library, gym, canteen, mess for hostelers, medical facilities, and a sports room. Hostelers did not like the mess food though, but there is a canteen for them. I like the college infrastructure. There are separate labs for each branch.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a very good infrastructure, course curriculum and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: EMPI is far from the hustle and bustle of the city and situated amidst the greenery of South Delhi. It is equipped with all the necessary state-of-the-art modern facilities. The best thing is the AI lab, which does not usually find in other B-schools.

Malla Reddy University powered by Sunstone flagship programmes include BBA and MBA, offered in full-time mode on the basis of merit. MRUH powered by Sunstone offers a BBA for 3 years and an MBA for 2 years of duration Candidates must apply for the courses through the online application process.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Patna Science College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 3 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, faculty, and the best placement and a bright future in my college.
reviews.review_text: Free Wi-Fi for study is available, provided by the university. There are many classrooms for all semesters, and there is one big library. A personal room is provided in my hostel for each student and a higher percentage of students are allocated in my hostel, and free Wi-Fi is available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Patna Women's CollegeReviewed on 29 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Patna Women's College honest review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are just okay. No Wi-Fi facility and library are available. Canteen food is okay. Multiple other food corner options are also available. Basic medical facilities are available. A limited sports facility is also present.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Patna Women's CollegeReviewed on 21 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: If women safety is your priority you should choose this college.
reviews.review_text: You can access library study room till working hours and you had a canteen available. No hostel you can look for PG  where charges would be minimal to high. Wi-Fi was provided with limits canteen food was good and sanitation was maintained. You would be happy to see it.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Patna Women's CollegeReviewed on 18 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Patna Women's College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were good. Wi-Fi facility, projector, and library were present. Canteen food was also good in taste, and there was enough to eat. Basic medical facilities are available in our college. A limited sports facility was present on the college campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Bihar National College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 29 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best B.A. Sanskrit honors college in Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of my college are very good. If you talk about infrastructure, then it is also very good. There are so many departments here with so many courses. There are facilities like canteen, Wi-Fi, medical facilities, sports facilities, etc. Students can make a future in sports also.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Bihar National College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 25 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is totally worth your money.
reviews.review_text: Basic facilities like Wi-Fi and drinking water are available 24X7. Our classrooms are very good. Labs are functional and they equipped with all the needed laboratory equipment. Hostel is in good condition. One of the best parts is the medical facilities. So all good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Vanijya Mahavidyalaya, Patna UniversityReviewed on 18 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Really good college experience.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided us with free Wi-Fi. We had labs accessible to the students studying under a course that required laboratory. The classrooms are in good condition. We also got a library with numerous books, both course books and others. I didn't reside in the hostel, so I can't tell for sure what it's like and what the quality of everything is, but I had friends who did, and they said that it's above average at best.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Patna Women's CollegeReviewed on 8 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Average college life and future.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were decent. Wi-Fi was not available. Classrooms were too old. Library was present. Basic medical facility was present. Sports facilities were very limited. Canteen was not good at all on the campus.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Patna Science College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 22 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Very satisfying, very good infrastructure. All is good?
reviews.review_text:
Best infrastructure is provided for all students. Wi-Fi, classroom, and library are available. College has good facilities, including modern labs, a high-speed Wi-Fi connection, and separate libraries in all departments. 
Campus is surrounded by greenery, providing a peaceful learning environment.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Bihar National College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 16 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is very disappointing because of the faculty members there, otherwise, it is a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms and hostel have adequate facilities with free Wi-Fi and sanitation. The library has books of all kinds, from textbooks to novels. The campus is full of greenery, there are different kinds of flowers and plants around the college. The canteen has good sanitation, and the food is delicious and affordable, too.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Patna Science College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 7 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good college but not very good. A student who comes from rural areas should choose this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are very good. The building here is very good. There is a huge building for students. The infrastructure of my college I like very much because it is very large and closer to nature. The traffic in front of my college I dislike because it affects my traveling to my college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2021Offered by Patna Science College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 20 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Everything was fantastic.
reviews.review_text: Everything was good. Building and college campus were fantastic and wonderful. Hostel facilities were also good. The environment of education was also wonderful. Also, there was availability of Wi-Fi in college and hostel. A medical facility was also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Patna Women's CollegeReviewed on 3 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The title of the review is empowering women to quality education.
reviews.review_text: Our college has neat and clean classrooms and a smart board. The campus has Wi-Fi for students. There is a well-equipped library for various departments. It has a well-stocked library for the department. The college has a hostel with basic amenities. Mess and canteen provide quality food for students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Patna Science College, Patna UniversityReviewed on 28 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Day by day PSC is deteriorating in all terms which makes a college a perfect one.

reviews_list.review_title: A great college for management and sustainability aspirants.

review_content.Placements: 100 percent placement as of now reported from PGD-FM and PGD. The average package can be considered as 10.3 LPA. According to placement data, some of the major recruiters are Vedanta, EY, Hindalco, and PwC. The placement structure is well furnished with various opportunities. The curriculum prepares you well through internships, field visits, and practical assignments. Intern recruiters include the Ministry of Environment and the Forest Wildlife Institute of India, and many more.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus spans 230 acres, approximately situated on a lush green hilltop. The architecture is beautiful, incorporating open walk yards, classrooms are air-conditioned, the auditorium is well-maintained, and the library is multistoried. The computer centre is well-equipped; it runs GIS remote sensing software, statistical tools, etc. The library has a large print and digital collection, and an online public access catalog is available.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Forestry Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It is not a average B-School.

review_content.Placements: Speaking of our super seniors, the recruiters range from a diverse base, for example, consulting firms like EY to sustainability-focused companies and banks like WWF, UNDP, NABARD, and AXIS Bank. The average package is around 10 LPA, the median drops slightly to 8.8 LPA, and the highest is 20.50 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The institute offers a peaceful green campus. Along with some special complimentary spots like a grassland with a view of the dam reservoir, caves, and a spot known as Bhopal Point, from where you can get an elevated view of a part of Bhopal. Classrooms are well-maintained with most facilities provided, and the mess is managed by students themselves. The menu is balanced and hygienic. The only issue is that, as the number of students increases, the dining area is not sufficient for one-time dining. Sports facilities like volleyball, badminton, and a gym are available with proper coaches.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Forestry Management - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Vibrant campus and career focused.

review_content.Placements: Our course has nearly 100% placements, with packages ranging from 8.2 LPA to 20.5 LPA. The average package offered is 10.38 LPA. Top recruiters include Hindalco, ITC, EY, PwC, and WWF, offering roles in sustainability, ESG, and CSR. There are two internships that the college provides, summer and winter internships, where every student gets an internship through the institute.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus has Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, a computer centre with 24/7 access, and advanced software like SPSS and GIS tools. The library is multi-storeyed and air-conditioned, housing over 41,000 volumes, journals, e-books, and subscriptions to databases. The programme is fully residential with proper air-conditioned hostels, common rooms, a gym, sports facilities, and gear. The mess is a student-managed mess that serves very good quality and hygienic food. Doctors visit every alternate day at the hostels; basic health care and first aid are available on campus.

content.Infrastructure: The institute offers a peaceful green campus. Along with some special complimentary spots like a grassland with a view of the dam reservoir, caves, and a spot known as Bhopal Point, from where you can get an elevated view of a part of Bhopal. Classrooms are well-maintained with most facilities provided, and the mess is managed by students themselves. The menu is balanced and hygienic. The only issue is that, as the number of students increases, the dining area is not sufficient for one-time dining. Sports facilities like volleyball, badminton, and a gym are available with proper coaches.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Forestry Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Vibrant campus and career focused.

content.Placements: Our course has nearly 100% placements, with packages ranging from 8.2 LPA to 20.5 LPA. The average package offered is 10.38 LPA. Top recruiters include Hindalco, ITC, EY, PwC, and WWF, offering roles in sustainability, ESG, and CSR. There are two internships that the college provides, summer and winter internships, where every student gets an internship through the institute.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, a computer centre with 24/7 access, and advanced software like SPSS and GIS tools. The library is multi-storeyed and air-conditioned, housing over 41,000 volumes, journals, e-books, and subscriptions to databases. The programme is fully residential with proper air-conditioned hostels, common rooms, a gym, sports facilities, and gear. The mess is a student-managed mess that serves very good quality and hygienic food. Doctors visit every alternate day at the hostels; basic health care and first aid are available on campus.

paragraphs: IIFM has a multi-step admission process that students need to follow for admission. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the course-specific entrance exam followed by other selection rounds (if applicable). A step-by-step admission process is mentioned in detail:
1: IIFM Bhopal Application Process 2026

Aspirants can apply online for the MBA course. Candidates need to pay an application fee of INR 1,500 (INR 1,000 for SC/ ST/ DA). Candidates have to first register to generate login credentials and then fill out the application form.
2: IIFM Bhopal Selection Rounds

Candidates applying for MBA courses are shortlisted based on MAT/ XAT/ GMAT/ CAT/ CMAT scores followed by a PI round. Admission to the PhD programme shall be through an entrance test conducted by the FRI deemed to be a university once a year preferably during the month of June-July followed by an interview of the candidates who will qualify for the entrance test. The selection for certificate courses is based on the merit of the candidates in the last qualifying exam.
3: IIFM Bhopal Admission Confirmation

After completion of the selection process, the institute sends an offer letter to the selected aspirants. Once the offer letter is issued to the students, the last date to pay the fee is intimated. Aspirants need to pay theIIFM Bhopal feeto confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: Is the IIFM Bhopal fee refundable for certificate course?
faqs.answer: IIFM Bhopal refunds the complete fee in case the host cancels the course. The host is not liable for any other charges that candidate incurred. The course fee for certificate course is INR 36,000. The payment of fee can be done in two installments.

faqs.question: Can I join IIFM Bhopal directly?
faqs.answer: IIFM Bhopal does not offer direct admission to MBA, PhD or FPM courses. Candidates have to qualify any of the accepted entrance-exams. The institute considers CAT, MAT, CMAT, XAT or GMAT for admission to MBA course. The selection for PhD course is based on FRIDU entrance test. For certificate courses, admission is based on merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam.

faqs.question: Is CMAT compulsory for MBA at IIFM Bhopal?
faqs.answer: CMAT is one of the accepting exams for IIFM Bhopal MBA course. However, it not mandatory to have a valid CMAT score for admission to MBA programme. Aspirants who have passed CAT, XAT, MAT or GMAT can also apply for admission. Besides entrance exam, candidates must also fulfil the eligibility requirements. A minimum of graduation is required for MBA admission.

faqs.question: How to get a PhD seat at the Indian Institute of Forest Management Bhopal?
faqs.answer: The allocation process for Indian Institute of Forest Management Bhopal PhD seats consists of various steps. Candidates can check below to know how to get a PhD seat at IIFM Bhopal:1.Visit the official website of the institute to perform an eligibility check.2.Fill out the application form available on the official website.3.If shortlisted, appear for the institute-level test, i.e., RAT. Those who qualify RAT are further invited for the PI process.4.Stay updated with the merit list. If shortlisted, report at the institute for the document verification process and payment of fees.

faqs.question: What to do after applying for the IIFM Bhopal Doctoral Programme in Management (DPM) course?
faqs.answer: Once the students have submitted the application forms, the selection committee at the Indian Institute of Forest Management begins the screening process. The committee conducts the evaluation process based on their score in the national-level entrance test, followed by an institute-level written test and PI session. After that, the institute releases a merit list with the names of the students suited for the programme.

paragraphs: Praxis Business School admissions 2026 are entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process for Praxis Business School admissions 2026:
Step 1: Praxis Business School Application Process 2026

The admission process at Praxis Business School for 2026 begins with the application process. Aspirants must visit the official website to apply for the desired course. The application fee for the FPM course is INR 1,000.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to Praxis Business School's PGDM programme involves a rigorous selection process. Candidates must qualify for the entrance examinations such as CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT, ATMA, or GMAT. The final selection is done based on the Written Ability Test & Personal Interview + Profile-Based Selection Criteria.
Apart from the PGDM course, aspirants must appear for an Online MCQ test on research aptitude and an interview (offline if possible, else online) to enrol for the FPM courses.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

Upon completion of the selection rounds, candidates who have qualified will participate in the counselling process. Praxis Business School will release the merit list of selected candidates in various rounds. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay thePraxis Business School feeto confirm their seats in the institute.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at Praxis Business School?
faqs.answer: MBA postings at Praxis Business School are generally successful. The school is very focused on placements, and it has a dedicated cell that works with students to prepare them for the process. The university also has a strong network of alumni who may help link students to possible possibilities. For the 2023 placement season, Praxis Business School's top package for MBA students was INR 17.60 LPA, while the base package was INR 9.46 LPA. Top employers included PwC, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, EY, Bandhan Bank, Tata Metaliks, Deloitte, KPMG, Axis Bank, HSBC, and Titan. In general, Praxis Business School should be taken into consideration by students seeking a business school with excellent placement rates. reviews.review_heading: Praxis is a place to learn, grow, and thrive.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include Wi-Fi, digital classrooms, library, green campus, gym, basketball ground, seminar hall, and indoor sports. Food quality is average and could be a little more pocket-friendly. Hostel life in Praxis is the best one can ask for. Late-night assignments, food, and music with friends make it a memorable experience. Most importantly, the hostel supervisors on our campus are extremely supportive and approachable, ensuring a safe and comfortable stay for all students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, Praxis gave me skills, confidence, and opportunities I am looking for.
reviews.review_text: The campus includes modern amenities like Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, auditorium-style lecture halls, recreation zones (pool, common rooms), medical facilities, reliable power backup, etc. Infrastructure is good, but it should increase the hostel accommodation as students outnumber the number of hostel rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are very good and helpful.
reviews.review_text: Number of rooms has increased from the previous year with an increase in the number of students. Wi-Fi is provided but sometimes the speed of the net becomes relatively low when a lot of students use it. I am a day scholar so don't know much about it but from the information I get hostel needs to be improved.

reviews.review_heading: From campus to corporate (my journey at Praxis Business School).
reviews.review_text: Facilities are Wi-Fi, digital classrooms, library, green campus, canteen, badminton ground, gym, basketball ground, seminar hall, and indoor sports. Food quality is good, but according to me, it is a little bit expensive, and we had all sports and game equipment.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, good placements.
reviews.review_text: I found the hostels very good. They provide personal rooms for residential students, so there's no issue with personal space. The hostel mess provides healthy food options. There are table tennis, basketball courts, and volleyball courts for sports enthusiasts. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The campus is beautiful and it's an ideal place to grow, nurture your skills, and learn new things.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and internships.
reviews.review_text: We have well-equipped classrooms with Wi-Fi facilities. There is a big accessible library. We have Wi-Fi  in hostels too with two operating canteens with good food quality. Medical facilities are available 24*7. We have lots of sports activities that keep happening in our campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements, amazing teachers, and continuous learning experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with 24x7 availability of internet, and bright and spacious classrooms. The library is accessible to students any time of the day and students can sit and study without any disturbance. Not only academic infrastructure, Praxis offers students activities like badminton, table tennis, and basketball.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Praxis Business School.
reviews.review_text: The facilities at Praxis Business School are the best for students. It is loaded with a mixture of fun, seriousness, research, and excitement. It boasts a sizeable campus with a gym, two canteens, a library, and basketball and badminton courts. It has a tech complex, amphitheater-style classrooms, corridors, and transition areas that promote interaction between faculty members and students. It features a co-ed hostel with all essential amenities and the highest level of safety.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is good in terms of return on investment.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is a bit costly but is very clean and hygienic. Wi-Fi won't work well in the hostel. Our classrooms are very good. The auditorium is well-designed. There is no ground to play football and cricket. Our college has a badminton and basketball court.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with ROI, great faculty, good campus, and great facilities.
reviews.review_text: There are two big air-conditioned auditoriums, mostly our classes are conducted there. Classrooms are neat and clean. There is free Wi-Fi and a spacious library with many books to study. All are single rooms provided in the hostel but the hotel fees are too expensive Rs.50,000 for 6 months. Food quality is good and has two canteens. Food expenses are not included with the hostel charges. College provides an online platform for articles and any kind of book. We are provided with all sorts of faci...

reviews.review_heading: Very impressive return of investment.
reviews.review_text: Books are available in the library. Classrooms are auditoriums and have a projector, whiteboard, speaker, and microphone. We have all kinds of sports like badminton, cricket, volleyball, table tennis, etc. Overall I would say, the facilities are very premium. Talking of the hostels, the corridors and rooms are neat and clean and are very hygienic also. Single rooms are available. 2 canteens are there nearby. Better to stay in the hostel than stay outside. Foods are good in a hostel and better th...

reviews.review_heading: Praxis Business School : 100% placement with excellent faculties at cheapest price in Kolkata
reviews.review_text: Facilities were excellent with high and upgraded classrooms. Now talking about infrastructure its has 1 main academic block, consisting classroom, library, cafeteria. Whole buildings are Wi-Fi free and classrooms have A.C. It has an auditorium where industry speaker sessions happen every week. The hostel building consisting of single rooms for a single student with 2 cafes, common rooms, gym, volleyball court, TT court, carrom, billiard board and badminton court.

reviews.review_heading: This college is for best career opportunities.
reviews.review_text: It provides big classrooms with an air conditioner facility, free Wi-Fi, a good library, and everything is good. college_info.intro:
The Post Graduate Program in Applied Marketing at Altera Institute is a 15-month, industry-backed programme for digital and AI careers. This courses is ideal for students aiming for roles in Brand Management, Product Management, Founders’ Office, Growth Marketing and Business Strategy.
The Altera PGP is superior to the traditional MBA in the following ways:
100% Industry-Designed Curriculum: The curriculum at Altera Institute includes relevant programmes that are not usually taught in several other B-schools such as Product Management, Digital Commerce, Digital Business Management, and Growth Marketing. This design institute prepares students not just for various exams but also for various high-impact roles.
Application-First Pedagogy: Altera’s “learning by doing” approach emphasizes hands-on application over theoretical learning. Students participate in term projects, weekly simulations, case sprints, and market immersions to build expertise in various real-world scenarios.
100% Industry Mentors: Altera PGP's 100% of the curriculum delivery is done top industry practitioners, many of whom are senior leaders and CXOs. This practitioner-based teaching approach ensures that various students learn directly from several experts shaping the industry, gaining several insights and skills that standard business schools are not able to offer.
Lifelong Networks: Over the 15-month programme, students engage with more than 200 industry professionals. This includes 10-12 mentors each week. This extensive network includes various potential recruiters and also provides valuable connections in the business world.
Download the Altera Institute Brochure which explains in In-Depth why The Altera PGP is superior to the Traditional MBA

reviews.review_heading: Really Interesting and Industry-Backed Curriculum
reviews.review_text: The campus is located at DLF 9A, Phase 3, and it really looks like a corporate setup already, so that subconsciously, students feel like they are working in a real corporate setup. Faculty at Altera is very supportive and are industry experts in specific domains.

reviews.review_heading: Best college if you have a passion for applied marketing and related fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, with good-based camps for classes and breakout rooms for discussion and mock interviews. The canteen is nice, with great coffee and very reasonable as well. It is in DLF 9A building, and the view from the 14th floor is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: Great college for marketing careers.
reviews.review_text: The Campus, set within a sleek corporate building, combines youthful vibrancy with a professional tone. A cozy canteen adds charm, offering a perfect spot to work on the never-ending assignments and a library acting as a focal point for all the important business newspapers, magazines, and books.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best decisions for your career and growth.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are well-equipped with Wi-Fi and projectors. We also have access to a well-stocked library for research and study purposes, along with a recording room. We also have a canteen that serves ready-to-eat and drink options, and vending machines for quick snacks and beverages. Altera does not have its own hostel; it offers housing options that are optional. Currently, I'm staying in a PG.

reviews.review_heading: India's only marketing B-school.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is beautifully designed to accommodate a basecamp, library, several breakout rooms, cafe, and office room. The institute is very helpful in finding students a place for accommodation if they are coming from outside Gurgaon, and like me from Bengaluru.

reviews.review_heading: Best marketing school in India.
reviews.review_text: The canteen is really good, and there are breakout rooms for group activities. The base camps are where classes take place. The hostel is the best in Gurugram, but the cost is a little high. However, that's to be expected in a place like Gurugram. The food and water are great, and travel time is about 15 minutes.

reviews.review_heading: Do a practical MBA which would actually help you in real life.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is really nice and has a corporate essence. We actually feel like we are in an office. We have breakout rooms with whiteboards for discussion, where we do our group projects. Our college has collaborated with a co-living space, and the amenities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: College review and placements statistics.
reviews.review_text: The batch strength is 42. There is a basecamp for teaching sessions. The college offers a canteen, a library, and medical facilities. The campus is equipped with WiFi. There are 4 meeting rooms where the students can discuss assignments given to them.

reviews.review_heading: Holistically designed curriculum and gold-class Mentors.
reviews.review_text: So Karan, Aalekh, and Shagun personally chose the hostel facility for our batch, because they wanted students to just study and not worry about the food or living quality, so you can just imagine the level of quality if founders are putting so much focus into this. The best thing about the hostel is those Friends! They will be your family in tough times since the course is very intense and challenging. Flxho had a very warm environment, the staff was very friendly, and hygiene was just first cla...

reviews.review_heading: Best Marketing Institute .
reviews.review_text: Great overall experience, the campus is situated in heart of Gurgaon- Cybercity, the campus provides a comprehensive corporate setup. Hostel is provided by the institution though it is not mandatory to opt for it. They are also changing to a bigger campus.

faqs.question: How much is the fee for BBA course at BBDU?
faqs.answer: The total course fee for BBA ranges between INR 2.40 Lacs and INR 4.2 lakh. reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is very good. Labs, classrooms and library are well maintained and properly equipped. Hostels are in good condition, though not perfect. Mess food is sometimes good and sometimes average, while the canteen food is quite good. Medical facilities are av...

reviews.review_heading: The college is quite good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi works well, labs are fantastic, and classrooms are spacious and well-equipped. The library is big. Hostels are not very suitable for living. Mess food is so bad that people sometimes get sick. Facilities at BBD (Babu Banarasi Das) institutions in Lucknow generally receive mixed reviews, with hostels often rated average to poor (especially food quality), while medical and sports facilities are usually available. Wi-Fi, libraries, and labs are generally well-regarded.

reviews.review_heading: The college is decent in terms of placement, and the quality of study is good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is very good because the buildings are well-maintained, and a beautiful infrastructure is provided by the college. The internal structure of my building is very good. Classrooms are well-maintained, and a digital board is present in all classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: College is good only for rich people, and if anyone comes from middle class, then this is not good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good. Everything is very much okay. But the hostel facilities are not good. The food in the mess is very poor quality. The hostel fees are also very high, they charge 80,000 per annum for three B. Ed rooms, and they don’t provide facilities like high-end amenities. They give only one almirah and one B. Ed with table and chair, and the rooms are very small, so it’s not good.

reviews.review_heading: Small talks about college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, not that bad. It's in working condition and maintained. It's okay working, but they upgraded their infrastructure last year, but it's not that good. They were updated from the last one we had before, so it’s okay, but not that okay. You can work with it.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college to take admission in.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Banarasi Das University is not that great. It has average infrastructure. It has a large library, and they also provide Wi-Fi to all the departments. The quality of the hostel is average, and the food was okay. This college also provided a mess.

reviews.review_heading: BBDU Lucknow offers great faculty, placements, and a lively campus for learning and growth.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in my course are very good. We get many seminars, we have labs and a classroom with video representation, a proper quiz, and fully AC, centralized AC, and many books related to our course. Our hostel is also good with full safety and security, and we have a proper medical area where students get proper treatment, and the quality of food is also good. There are many options on the menu that they cook regularly, and we also have a proper play area in our hostel.

The course completion, the sports game facilities, medical facilities, and mess and canteen facilities are also good.

reviews_list.review_title: Goldmine for hardworking students.

review_content.Placements: Around 90% of students are placed in the last year of 2024. 100-200 students can easily grab 10 LPA on campus if they do hard work. Top recruiting companies involved Goldman Sachs, De Shaw, Atlassian, Microsoft, and ZS Associates. There is no official data for on-campus internships, but students often easily crack internships in their 3rd or final year from off campus. Top roles include SDE, system engineer and data analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: MAIT offers decent infrastructure for CSE students with reliable Wi-Fi in academic blocks, well-maintained computer labs equipped with usable systems, clean classrooms with projectors, and a quiet, resourceful library that's great for long study hours. The hostel facilities are average. Rooms are clean and basic, washrooms are maintained regularly, and hot water usually works fine. The mess food is manageable, but not something you'll look forward to every day, it's mostly repetitive but edible. The canteen is better than the mess, with more variety and better taste. Medical facilities are available on campus for basic needs.

review_content.Infrastructure: Classes can be good, seats are like school, and they teach on whiteboards it's such an old method. There are 6 canteens. The food is good, and the prices are also low. We have Nescafé, Amul, and local canteens. We have a sports ground, a badminton court, a basketball court, and a cricket practice net. It also has a hospital for emergencies.

The Institute has experienced faculty offering the best education to students. On the basis of Shiksha verified reviews, Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology has a rating of 3.9 by students. review_summary.college_name: Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Advance Communication Technology) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is an outstanding college as compared to other IPU colleges.

content.Placements: Placements were average. Around 45-50% of students got placed. The highest package was more than 20 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, and Infosys visited. Internships were limited and mostly obtained through self-efforts. The college offers many roles in academics and sports also.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is quite good. Labs, classrooms, and the library are all well maintained. Students can use books from the library to avoid expenses and to buy books. Sports facilities are available. Several canteens are on campus. Medical facilities are available in case of emergency.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Not very satisfied because placements have been going down right after I joined.

content.Placements: As I am in the 2027 batch, no students are placed right now. Our batch has just started the 6th sem, and regarding internships, I have heard from seniors that companies come after the 6th semester for internships, and Visa has recently come to our campus for hiring interns, and we might get good placement in 2027.
content.Infrastructure: The college campus is good but not too big. It's average, we have a playing area, ground, and all basic facilities like Wi-Fi, a good library, and drinking water, and canteens are okay too, not very good, but they are good, and 1 doctor is always available on the campus. I personally have visited him.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Goldmine for hardworking students.

content.Placements: Around 90% of students are placed in the last year of 2024. 100-200 students can easily grab 10 LPA on campus if they do hard work. Top recruiting companies involved Goldman Sachs, De Shaw, Atlassian, Microsoft, and ZS Associates. There is no official data for on-campus internships, but students often easily crack internships in their 3rd or final year from off campus. Top roles include SDE, system engineer and data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: MAIT offers decent infrastructure for CSE students with reliable Wi-Fi in academic blocks, well-maintained computer labs equipped with usable systems, clean classrooms with projectors, and a quiet, resourceful library that's great for long study hours. The hostel facilities are average. Rooms are clean and basic, washrooms are maintained regularly, and hot water usually works fine. The mess food is manageable, but not something you'll look forward to every day, it's mostly repetitive but edible. The canteen is better than the mess, with more variety and better taste. Medical facilities are available on campus for basic needs.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied from the college.

content.Placements: 80% of students got placed on campus, the lowest package is 3.2 LPA, and the highest is 1.2 crore per annum in a US-based firm. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Amazon, Deloitte, Infosys, TCS, and ZS Associates. About 20% of students got internships. Top roles offered are Data Scientist, ML Engineer, and Software Developer.
content.Infrastructure: Classes can be good, seats are like school, and they teach on whiteboards it's such an old method. Labs are good, we have good computers, and the library is also great; we have a separate building. However, the Ethernet speed is slow, around 10MB/s. Wi-Fi is present, but the speed is too slow. There are 6 canteens. The food is good, and the prices are also low. We have Nescafé, Amul, and local canteens. We have a sports ground, a badminton court, a basketball court, and a cricket practice net. It also has a hospital for emergencies.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Disappointed with the written work and Wi-Fi speed available inside the college premises.

content.Placements: 80 percent of students get placement. 1.34 off-campus is the highest, and 4 LPA is the lowest package. Infosys and TCS are the top recruiting companies. Samsung and other companies offer internships to almost all students. Software engineer roles are offered to most of the students who top.
content.Infrastructure: Very slow-speed Wi-Fi is provided, and the infrastructure of classrooms is also poor. The library is decent, and Ethernet is provided, but again, the speed is slow. The college provides necessary infrastructure, facilities, and equipment for engineering students, including clean, well-maintained classrooms with smart boards. Hostel facilities are available for male students only, accommodating about 186 students in single, double, or four-bed rooms.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Information Technology - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty, and strong IT learning experience with decent placements

review_content.Placements: 80 percent of students were placed. The highest packages are up to 150 LPA (international) and 60 LPA (domestic), with the average package around 5–6 LPA, and the lowest around 2.5–3.5 LPA per holder. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Adobe, Amazon, Wipro, Deloitte, TCS, Capgemini, and Infosys. About 30 percent of students reported internships in companies like Google, Zscaler, Hike, IBM, and Amazon.
review_content.Infrastructure: The university offers good facilities for the B.Sc. IT department, including high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, and a resourceful central library. Hostels are clean, secure, and provide Wi-Fi, 24/7 electricity, and common rooms. The mess and canteen food are hygienic and decent, with multiple options. Medical needs are handled through an on-campus health centre with first-aid and ambulance availability. The campus also has indoor and outdoor sports facilities, including grounds, courts, and recreation areas. Overall, the infrastructure is well-maintained and student-friendly.

Hostels are clean, secure, and provide Wi-Fi, 24/7 electricity, and common rooms. The mess and canteen food are hygienic and decent, with multiple options. Medical needs are handled through an on-campus health centre with first-aid and ambulance availability. The campus also has indoor and outdoor sports facilities, inclu...

reviews.review_heading: This college is good. I like this college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and library are available. Classrooms are also good, they are clean. But there is network issue. The phone's network didn't come, so we can't use the net properly. Wi-Fi network also doesn't work properly. Library is good, and so many books available in the library. Food is not that' much good.

reviews.review_heading: Uit BCA course Dehradun.
reviews.review_text: There are always many complaints regarding the hostel facilities, which are also not being properly taken care of by the college itself. Food is very degraded and not prepared hygienically. Most of the students prefer to take flats outside the college premises to avoid such conditions.

reviews.review_heading: BCA course in UIT- USCS Dehradun.
reviews.review_text: The classroom is maintained properly, along with which proper cleaning takes place every day. The class size for one batch of BCA is around 76 students. Wi-Fi facilities are not good on campus, and in the hostel, asking for Wi-Fi facilities is way too costly.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and all the necessary facilities are available in this college.
reviews.review_text: I am very much like the infrastructure of this college. Additionally, the college provides all necessary facilities, including free Wi-Fi. Furthermore, the classrooms are spacious. Our college has three to four sports grounds, as well as a library area where you can borrow books for your course.

reviews.review_heading: UIT College in Dehradun is the best among private colleges.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are pretty average. There are various restrictions regarding outing time, you are not allowed to go out of hostel after 7 pm, which can be considered a disadvantage. More than college has strict rules regarding maintaining a proper dress code.

reviews.review_heading: BCA course in UIT Dehradun.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is too good, it is what you expect from a private college, and the college is considered good among most of the private colleges of Dehradun. The college also provides bus facilities for day scholar students. In addition to this, the college also has an E-vehicle on the campus to avoid walking from one department to another.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with respect to infrastructure and fee structure.
reviews.review_text: The college has built hostels inside the campus itself, which are mainly triple or double sharing. These hostels provide you with food facilities, and the rooms are also pretty spacious.

reviews.review_heading: Great college for BCA at UIT.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very spacious and very well-maintained by the college. The classrooms have proper seating, a centralized area wherever needed, and projectors are also there for presentation, which helps faculty members in proper teaching. The college also consists of a library for which you have to issue our library card through which you can get your books. There is no need to buy your own books.

reviews.review_heading: UIT offers BCA and other courses.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is clean and well-maintained. The labs are also well-equipped with updated systems and computers used for practical works and technical courses. The college also provides Wi-Fi facilities which are available all the time. The college has a strict rule and regulation regarding the attendance criteria. Also, the college has its own uniform.

reviews.review_heading: UIT Dehradun is the best college.
reviews.review_text: The campus is clean and has good facilities like labs, a library, and sports facilities. Fests and cultural events keep the college life fun. Also, there are many fests held during the year in which you can participate and join. Many VIPs or singers are also invited to these fests.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for BCA engineering.
reviews.review_text: The college has a great infrastructure situated on acres of land with greenery and a beautiful mountain view of Dehradun. The college is situated on the outskirts of Dehradun, which is approximately 20 km from the bus stand or railway station. The college also has decent classrooms with well-furnished furniture.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college in Dehradun.
reviews.review_text: College is very well maintained with spacious classrooms and modern labs with every necessary equipment required. The college also provides you with Wi-Fi connectivity 24*7. The hostel facilities in the college are average. Most of the students do not like the hostels, so they prefer to stay outside in PGs and other rooms.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good, but the infrastructure needs to be improved.

content.Placements: About 100 percent of the seats were occupied by my batch this year. The highest package offered is 6.5 LPA (average) and the lowest is 3.6 LPA. I am a fresher, so I do not know anything about other questions. The package thing was recommended by a senior. Overall, it is good.
content.Infrastructure: There is a digital classroom with internet service. Quality is good, but not satisfactory. Food quality is average. Sports and games are good. There is no Wi-Fi on my campus. There is no proper management. The management needs to improve, especially the low-ranking staff.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Centurion University review.

content.Placements: The placement in our course was the best among all courses. The placement percentage was around 85–90 percent. The highest package was also secured by our course only, i.e., 22 LPA. The average package was around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Deloitte, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facilities, a library, and modern classrooms were available. Computer labs, laboratories, and workshops were well equipped with instruments. Hostel quality was also good. Sports and games were encouraged by the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Our college gives the best education and skills.

content.Placements: I am currently in my 3rd year. My super seniors got normal jobs in companies. But still, our college management is trying to give the best jobs to the students. 40 percent of students were placed in my college. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The best thing about my college is the hostel. They provide two different types of food, like northern and southern style food. I have tried both types of food, but North-style food is better than South-style. I can give 4 stars out of 5 stars to my college hostel facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Colorful campus and opportunity to grow

content.Placements: I joined in September. In our class there are 60 students and many other sections. I have heard from seniors that the average package is around 3 to 4 LPA. Mostly small and midfirm companies are coming and intership is not so mandatory. It mostly will depend on our skills and our willingness to learn.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-fi is available and a full network. Computer labs are there for learning communication and presentation. Classrooms have AC and best seats to attend classes. I am not a hosteler but I have eaten once. I did not like it so much. Good enough to live. Sports facilities are the best. You can play basketball cricket tennis and coaches are there. A small hospital is there for small health issues.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and fantastic infrastructure, but the hostel mess food is just average.

content.Placements: For our BBA batch, the placement rate is quite high, officially around 90%. The salary packages have a wide range. The highest package goes up to 13.60 LPA. The median package is 4.00 LPA. On average, most students receive offers between 2.5 LPA and 3.5 LPA, with the lowest packages being around 1.5 LPA. Our top recruiting companies include major banks like ICICI, HDFC, and Axis Bank. As well as IT companies like Accenture, Wipro, and Cognizant. Almost everyone, 60-100 percent, manages to get an internship as it is a key part of our course.

admission_overview.college_name: Centurion University of Technology and Management, Paralakhemundi Course Admissions 2025: Eligibility, Selection Process & Dates

paragraphs: Centurion University Paralakhemundi admission 2024is online and offline. Centurion University of Technology and Management (CUTM), through eight schools, offers UG, PG, and other courses to students across Engineering, Management, Science, and other streams. Admission to various UG, PG, and other courses is based on merit and scores secured in entrance exams. At the UG level,Centurion University Paralakhemundioffers four-year BTech, four-year BSc, three-year BCA, BBA, and other courses to students.

At the PG level, the university offers two-year MBA, MSc, and other courses to students. To get admission to any courses students are required to complete the eligibility and selection criteria set by the college for admission. Want to know more about Centurion University Paralakhemundi admission, along with course-wise eligibility, selection criteria, seat intake, fees and admission process:

Students seeking admission are advised to check the course-specific eligibility conditions before applying. The final seat allotment is done only for students who meet eligibility and selection criteria. To confirm admission, selected candidates have to pay some amount of the course fees at the time of admission. The table presentsCenturion University Paralakhemundi coursesalong with course eligibility and selection criteria:

Centurion University Paralakhemundi feeis a sum of multiple components such as tuition fee, caution deposit, exam fee, etc. Some of the fee components like caution deposit are one-time paid while tuition fee is paid annually. Coming to affordability is one of the strong reasons why many don't opt for a degree or a college. While the availability of education loans and scholarships has made education accessible. However, the terms and conditions required to become eligible for a student loan or a scholarship often stand as a challenge. Centurion University Paralakhemundi seat intakevaries course-wise. Candidates are offered seats based on their merit. Once the seat is allotted, candidates are required to pay the course fee to confirm their admission. Below is the intake for top Centurion University Paralakhemundi courses:
Note:This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Centurion University follows a process for admissions to its various courses. Each aspirant goes through the admission stages till the final seat allotment. Largely, the admission process involves an application process, entrance examination, counselling, and admission confirmation. Details on each of these admission stages are provided below for a better understanding of the students:
STEP 1: Centurion University Paralakhemundi Application Process2024

Candidates willing to get admission to Centurion University can apply forCUEEfrom the official website with an option to pay and submit the form online or pay and submit the form offline. The aspirants opting for the online application method are required to visit the official website of the University(www.cutm.ac.in).

After the completion of registration, the University will conduct the CUEE exam. Applicants are required to appear for the exam at the notified test centre. Qualified applicants will be called up to take provisional admission by depositing a minimum admission fee via cash/DD at the University campus or online on the website.
STEP 2: Shortlisting Students

Centurion University Entrance Examination (CUEE) is conducted by Centurion University, Odisha for admissions to various undergraduate and postgraduate courses. The online remote-proctored test is a 3-hour long exam. The students with a valid score and meeting the cutoff are called for the next round of admission. For MTech courses, national-level exams, andGATEscores are accepted for shortlisting students.
STEP 3: Counselling

Candidates who score greater than or equal to the cutoff marks in the entrance examination have to participate in theCUEE counsellingprocess for admissions. The counselling is conducted in offline mode. The selected students have to report to the counselling venue and fill out their preferred courses. The seat allotment is done based on the candidate's merit, preference and availability of seats.
STEP 4: Admission Fee Payment & Seat Confirmation
After the final seat allotments, selected students can pay some amount of the admission fee and confirm their seats. The amount required to be paid can be confirmed by the university officials.

hostel_campus.college_name: SIOM - Sinhgad Institute of Management Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: Rooms have sufficient space and have attached bath cum lavatory and also have incoming telephone call facility. There is a separate wing for foreign students in two hostels. Additional facilities for cooking, washing etc. are also provided. Clean, hygienic and quality food is available at subsidized rates in the mess of all the hostels. There is a separate mess exclusively for girls in the campus. The convenience of non-vegetarian students is also looked after by a separate non-vegetarian mess in the campus. Canteens / fast food outlets serve snacks and refreshments to the students.

library.description: SIOM central library is enriched by 46500 books with 12000 titles of various books of all disciplines of Engineering, Management and Sciences. Along with 5000 reference books, the library also has 207 periodicals and journals out of which 143 are national and 59 international. Library has 76 Bound Volumes, mainly of IEEE transactions and ASME journals. The library also possesses 1300 CDs as offline databases. There are nine sectional libraries under the Central Library. A dedicated six storey building with huge Reading Halls and modern amenities is been allotted to the library facilities of the campus. The Central Library is open for 24 hours all days in a year, with a conducive atmosphere for study. The Central library has a seating capacity of more than 3500. The Central Library is automated with software called SLIM 21. Issuing system is implemented with barcode facility. Library also has in-house photocopy facility. IEEE, Science Direct and ProQuest databases can be accessed from the Digital Library facility.

reviews.review_heading: Best ROI, teaching, and college life.
reviews.review_text: The campus isn't big but there are many clubs and activities going on on campus. The campus has free Wi-Fi so students can learn online. The library is good; any student can take books by just showing their ID card. Sinhgad hostel is very big; we have to share rooms with friends. 3 students get one room with 3 beds, 1 fan,  2 tables, and 3 cupboards. Hostel food is disappointing; it is not good in quality or quantity. Canteen food is good but expensive; tea and breakfast (idli, dosa, samosas, pa...

reviews.review_heading: I have a lot of memories in this college.
reviews.review_text: College fees is around 1.2 lacs per year in which they provide good facilities to the students. They create free superset accounts for the students. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Labs are good but some PCs don't have a keyboard or mouse. College has it’s own library but the library hours are very less. If we compare the hostel and the PGs, the hostel has better options with the fees being less than that of the PG, also they provide good quality of food. We have 2 canteens in the campus. ...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in the year of 2022.
reviews.review_text: College fest, Sinhgad karandak, in the most celebrated event which is held around Jan-Feb of every year. We have separate floors for all the departments which cause us to face lift issues a lot many times. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel and the library. Our classrooms are very big having many windows, projectors and boards. Hostel is seperate for boys and girls. Food quality is not good but the canteen’s food is of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SIOM - Sinhgad Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure and campus building are decent, with separate buildings for MBA and MCA. But we have a combined campus and sports ground. Wi-Fi is also available on campus, but the downloading speed is very low. Classrooms are big. The hostel is on campus, but I stayed in a flat because of the food. They have poor quality food. We complained many times to hostel management, but no action is taken.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with placement.
reviews.review_text: I do not like campus, like here students get frustrated by lectures and assignments; they have not organized any visits or trips. The college infrastructure is decent, but some benches are broken. Wi-Fi speed was too low no interest to use it. Library is decent; they have all the books. The hostel is bad; the rooms are small, the food is very bad, and no proper cleaning got done. The canteen food was good; they have AC. Sports ground is big, but there are no sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of Sinhgad institute of management.
reviews.review_text: The college has one building where we have a common sports ground with MBA students. Wi-Fi speed is too low. Classroom desks are broken, and library staff behaviour is very rude. Hostel rooms are good but mess food is the worst. We can not change mess service. Canteen food is good but it crowds every time we have to wait for a table.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SIOM - Sinhgad Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: Our college is very big with 2-3 grounds for us to play. The annual fest named KARANDAk has events, competitions, stalls, etc. In classrooms, we have CCTV, projectors, clean benches, and fans. We all students and alumni are connected on WhatsApp, they help us in the hiring process. The hostel is good; they have big rooms, sometimes we faced electricity problems. Mess food is healthy, non-veg options are also available. Sports competitions are held in the annual fest.

reviews.review_heading: College makes us good finance analyst.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is vibrant and big. In classrooms, we have comfortable seating arrangement, AC, whiteboards, projectors, etc. The library has many books and journals. The hostel is good, but due to a bad food issue, stay in a PG. At 1km from campus, there are many PGs and flats available. The canteen is big enough; they have good food. The hostel needs to get food from the canteen. No medical facilities or claims are provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty and placement.
reviews.review_text: Sinhgad infrastructure is top class; our campus is filled with beautiful stress. Wi-Fi is available from 9 am to 7 pm only. Classrooms are well-maintained, and we have a big auditorium where events and expert talks are organized. Hostels offer a variety of shared or single rooms, and the mess food quality is good, with both non-veg and veg options available.

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied. It is good.

content.Placements: The highest package is 16 LPA, the lowest is 5.5 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Top recruiters include ITC, Birla Opus, PwC, KPMG, EY GDS, HDFC Bank, and SBI Mutual Fund. individual_reviews.course: MBA (Global) in collaboration with MUST, Malaysia - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A journey to the next level.

content.Placements: CRP tries their level best to bring corporates to the Campus and maintain a long-term relationship with them. They always try to maintain the average placement package and try to increase it. Each and every year, they try to bring some new companies for both internships and placements.
content.Infrastructure: In terms of infrastructure and hostel, Globsyn is one of the best in Bengal. The college has library, game rooms, halls for meetings, board rooms and everything. individual_reviews.title: Excellent campus, very good teachers.

individual_reviews.title: The goal of doing extraordinary things.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied. It is good.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms are Wi-Fi connected and equipped with projectors. The library is well-maintained, and there are yoga classes and a playground. Facilities are good. Different food items are provided on different days, and cleanliness is carefully maintained. The food quality is good, and RO water is available.

reviews.review_heading: A journey to the next level.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure and hostel, Globsyn is one of the best in Bengal. The college has library, game rooms, halls for meetings, board rooms and everything. Specifically, I would like to mention one thing: after joining a corporation, the basic treatment a candidate gets remains the same after joining Globsyn.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus, very good teachers.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure and highly disciplined. Very well-maintained canteen with good quality food. The campus is equipped with modern facilities. There are a lot of events that help students to upgrade themselves. A medical facility is available. Wi-Fi facility is available.

reviews.review_heading: The goal of doing extraordinary things.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure provided by the college are excellent, including hostel facilities, high-quality food in the canteen, maintained cleanliness, an up-to-date medical room, and sports facilities with a huge playground.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with supportive faculty and good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: A modern campus with Wi-Fi, Computer Labs, and faculty members is good. A digital library with access to journals and e resources. The campus is well maintained. Basic medical support is available, and cultural activities are also regularly organised, and 24/7 security is available.

reviews.review_heading: I'm extremely honored to be a part of Globsyn Family.
reviews.review_text: Globsyn Business School provides amazing facilities and modern infrastructure for students, starting from Wi-Fi connections, air-conditioned classrooms and a wide variety of books available in the library. It serves premium quality of various food items at an affordable price.

reviews.review_heading: It was a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The institute has good infrastructure like - library, classrooms and books are available. Also, I would appreciate the college's library, where we can go and read, even the newspapers. Even in any circumstances, RO will help the students.

reviews.review_heading: From Campus to Corporate : How Globsyn Business School shapes careers.
reviews.review_text: Globsyn has a beautiful 8-acre campus on the outskirts of Kolkata. Globsyn has state of the art infrastructure with Wi-Fi enabled classrooms, a well-stocked library, an open-air cafeteria, a study lounge, a research centre, a Universal Human Values Centre (dedicated towards spirituality) and other services. Globsyn has a hostel inside its campus for only girls. It also has a hostel property (10 mins from GBS), where both male and female students can reside, with separate hostels for both, mainta...

reviews.review_heading: Holistic growth, A grade placement support and top class education, all in one.
reviews.review_text: The campus has Wi-Fi facilities everywhere and all the classrooms have audiovisual learning facilities. The library has plenty of resources for enriching management students. The hostels are on campus and also off-campus. Medical facilities are okay with a standard infirmary. Annual Sports event 'Titanium' is the center of excitement for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Journey as an MBA graduation.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available in our college. We have e-classrooms, a boardroom, space for extracurricular activity, well-equipped library, and plenty of space for fun and games. Hostel is not with the college. It is situated 5 KM away from the college. The college will provide a bus facility for all its students.

reviews.review_heading: Fully recommended. Satisfied.
reviews.review_text: Students can focus more by moving away from commotion because the campus is located in a peaceful environment. There is a girl's hostel inside the campus. One more hostel is available outside the campus for both boys and girls. Other facilities available are Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, canteen and library.

reviews.review_heading: Industry focused learning with good corporate exposure.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available across the GBS campus. There are smart classrooms equipped with AC for comfortable sessions. The college has a well-stocked library with academic books, journals and research papers. Globsyn has a spacious classroom for guest lectures, seminars and corporate sessions.

reviews.review_heading: Globsyn is my second home were I have felt my winner qualities and abilities.
reviews.review_text: Although I did not opt for a hostel, I have heard about it from my friends. The food offered in the hostel feels like home, and adequate safety is provided to girls in the girls' hostel. However, the hostel follows strict rules. The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi for easy accessibility. The college canteen also offers good food.

reviews.review_heading: I am very much satisfied with the experience of learning, which shapes me and my thinking.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a high-speed internet facility. Classrooms and the library are well-equipped with digital learning tools. The hostel has good rooms with full AC. The canteen food is quite good, and they maintain hygiene and quality. Medical support is available, along with indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: It provided a transformative experience that changed my life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. It provides Wi-Fi all over the campus, a library with a touch of class, spacious classrooms, and a well-maintained canteen. The campus is fully air-conditioned. There is a big playground where the sports event happens. Overall, we have a thriving academic environment over here.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in the MBA programme at SIBM Nagpur?

Shortlisted students are evaluated further through a Group Exercise, Personal Interview, and Written Ability Test. SIBM Nagpur has a competitive selection process based on overall performance. Final admission is finalized after payment of fees and document verification.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for the MBA course at SIBM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: SIBM Nagpur MBA eligibility demands a bachelor's degree with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognised university. Final year students can also apply for the course. Admission is given on the basis of SNAP test scores and further selection rounds. SIBM Nagpur provides merit-based admission.

faqs.question: Is SNAP compulsory for MBA admission at SIBM Nagpur?
