faqs.question: What is the eligibility for the EMBA programme at SIBM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: SIBM Nagpur demands EMBA applicants to possess a bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% marks and full-time work experience of one year. The minimum marks considered for SC/ST candidates are 45%. Work experience should be held in a registered organisation or firm. Foreign graduates need to submit an AIU equivalence certificate.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for EMBA at SIBM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: The process of selection for the EMBA programme in SIBM Nagpur is comprised of just a personal interview round. Eligible candidates are invited for the interview. There is neither a written test nor a group discussion. Final admission is made purely based on interview performance.

faqs.question: What is the duration and intake of the EMBA at SIBM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: SIBM Nagpur provides the EMBA course in weekend mode for a period of two years. The Executive MBA student intake is limited to 30 seats. This format enables working professionals to pursue their job alongside. The course is structured to develop leadership and management capabilities.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at SIBM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: No, there is no direct admission in SIBM Nagpur as the MBA admission is entrance-based only. All applicants are required to appear for the SNAP test and subsequent selection rounds. There is neither any management quota nor admission without test. SIBM Nagpur has a fair and competitive admission procedure.

faqs.question: Does SIBM Nagpur accept admission through SNAP?
faqs.answer: Yes, SIBM Nagpur only accepts SNAP scores for admission to its full-time MBA course. Candidates need to appear for SNAP and obtain competitive scores in order to be shortlisted. Subsequent selection is done on the basis of group exercises, interviews, and written ability. SNAP is the only entrance test accepted by SIBM Nagpur.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at SIBM Nagpur without an entrance exam?
faqs.answer: SIBM Nagpur admission is not feasible without taking the SNAP entrance test. SNAP is necessary for every MBA candidate applying to SIBM Nagpur. The final selection also requires GE-PI-WAT after SNAP. The entrance exam is the first and obligatory step to secure admission.

faqs.question: How to get admission in SIBM Nagpur?
faqs.answer: In order to join SIBM Nagpur, candidates need to initially register and take the SNAP entrance test. On clearing, candidates are shortlisted for GE-PI-WAT rounds. Admission is in accordance with composite performance across all phases of selection. Final seat allocation in SIBM Nagpur is completed on payment of fees.

placement_data.title: SIBM Nagpur Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: SIBM Nagpur has released the interim placement report for its MBA and MBA FABM batch 2025. According to the report, the highest and average package offered to MBA students during SIBM Nagpur placements 2025 stood at INR 24.9 LPA and INR 12.33 LPA, respectively. The median package offered to the MBA batch 2025 was INR 12 LPA . Further, the highest and average packages offered to the MBA FABM batch 2025 stood at INR 18 LPA and INR 11.94 LPA , respectively. The median package offered was INR 10.2 LPA . Further, the highest and average package offered during MBA FABM placement 2025 was INR 18 LPA and INR 11.94 LPA.

Earlier, the highest and average package offered during MBA placements 2024 stood at INR 20 LPA and INR 8.45 LPA, respectively. The median package during MBA placements was INR 8 LPA . 54 new recruiters participated in SIBM Nagpur MBA placements 2024 and the highest PPO amount offered was INR 20 LPA . In addition to this, the highest and average packages offered to the MBA FABM batch 2022-24 were INR 18 LPA and INR 8.60 LPA , respectively. The median package stood at INR 7.20 LPA .

reviews.review_heading: A good MBA college for placements.
reviews.review_text: The courses provide facilities such as modern classrooms with AC, projectors, and comfortable seating. The labs are well-equipped, enhancing our learning experience. The library's vast collection and serene environment make it my favorite study spot on campus. The library environment is very energetic.

reviews.review_heading: A value-for-money college with good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Speaking about the college in terms of infrastructure, we cannot say it is not good. All basic infrastructure facilities and every service are available. Maintenance is needed at times in some areas that require attention. A proper canteen, bus facilities, parking facilities, common hall, library, and other necessary campus machinery facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is good. Overall, the experience is good.
reviews.review_text: My experience about the classroom is that the faculty are well-experienced and qualified. Wi-Fi is available at high speed. Sometimes, teachers are not good at teaching. Now, talking about the hostel, there are plenty of hostels available with a good Wi-Fi network and comfortable rooms, but the mess food was the worst. Everything tastes sweet, and it is the worst food ever.

reviews.review_heading: I am completely satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in our college are very good. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms are available. The best part of our college is the library. The library is large, and you may spend all your day there. The quality of meals served to the students is normal, but you'll also get dominos, subways, and many others. , which covers the mess meals. Medical centers are available. Sports facilities are great.

reviews.review_heading: A college with good facilities and placements.
reviews.review_text: For me, the facilities provided for the fee we pay are good and we have different labs and halls for different interactions with professors. The hostel facility is good and offers us single rooms with good amenities. The food offered in the dining court is cooked to good quality. A medical room is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement opportunities are offered to us.
reviews.review_text: The college has technology-driven study-related facilities, which include modern classrooms with computers at every table, seminar halls and an amphitheater. The college offers us a high-speed internet facility. My friends mostly prefer indoor sports. Hostel facilities are available for both girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good. It has two buildings. One building is for girls, and the other building is for boys. The hostel rooms are very good. We have a mess facility. It provides good and tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good. It has good environment. The hostel rooms are very good and huge. We have a good mess facility. The food served in the mess is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best with the placements.
reviews.review_text: Campus is spread across 80 acres with more than 1 sports ground, highly equipped labs, and workshops. College library is vast and classrooms are air-conditioned with free Wi-Fi services. Hostel is clean and hygienic. Mess food is fresh with many varieties.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best institute for management with great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In this college, the best infrastructure is provided in India. It has 80 acres of campus with world-class architecture displaying the scenic view from every corner of the campus. Classrooms are equipped with a centralized air conditioning system and good Wi-Fi networks are enabled throughout the campus. The hostel seems to be more of a 5-star hotel with great rooms and an attached washroom and the room is also equipped with air conditioning. The best-in-class sports facilities with every sports ...

reviews.review_heading: The corporate team of SIBM, Nagpur is very active with great contacts.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is quite average to stay in. The cupboard can be the issue as they do not provide enough space to keep our belongings. Hygiene is intact and great. We do not have much timing restrictions which mean you can sit in the central library and study late nights.

reviews.review_heading: A great business school with the best placements.
reviews.review_text: The College library is very big and contains almost all the books related to the course and major author's books. Classroom are air-conditioned for all students and labs are air-conditioned. College provides wi-fi service. Hostel is well maintained and the mess food is fresh. Sports ground is huge and well versed with all sports equipment.

faqs.question: What are the cutoff marks required for MBA at JIMS Kalkaji?
faqs.answer: The cutoff 'percentile' is around 60 for either of the exams CAT, XAT or MAT while ATMA results have not been released out yet. The cutoff marks for the exam vary almost every year since the difficulty of the exams always changes. We can expect the safe score for admission into JIMS would be around 30-50 out of a total of 198 marks would be enough for admission into JIMS Kalkaji.

faqs.question: What is the latest cutoff information for MBA at JIMS Kalkaji?
faqs.answer: The final decision regarding admission to the applicant for MBA will be based on academic performance. JIMS Delhi requires a minimum CAT cutoff of the 75 percentile. In order to graduate from any discipline, students must receive at least 55% of the possible points.If you are scoring 75% tile then you will also be getting some sort of scholarship.

faqs.question: What is the minimum cutoff for MBA at JIMS Kalkaji 2023?
faqs.answer: The minimum cutoff perccentile for MBA in JIMS Kalkaji is 60 in CAT or other similar exams like XAT, MAT. ATMA results will be out by the end of this month and it will be soon revealed what the cutoff as per ATMA is for JIMS Kalkaji, but it always ranges around 60-75 percentile almost every year for MBA in either of the courses, IB or Management.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in JIMS Kalkaji for MBA with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can get admission in this Institute with 60% in class 12th because they are mainly asking for your undergraduate degree marks which is to be at least 50% and other than that they are asking for any management entrance exam such as CAT, XAT, MAT, ATMA and others. They have set a cut off score of 60 percentile for CAT. CAT is one of the prestigious exam which is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management (IIM's) at various centres across India.

faqs.question: Can I join JIMS Kalkaji directly?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission at JIMS Kalkaji is not possible.  The college offers admission to PG-level courses in the stream of Management, namely PGDM and PGDM (International Business). JIMS Kalkaji admission is completely entrance-based. Candidates need to appear and qualify for any one of the national-level entrance exam, namely CAT, XAT, CMAT, etc. JIMS Kalkaji also conducts WAT and GD PI rounds for the final admission.

faqs.question: When are JIMS Kalkaji application forms out?
faqs.answer: They are already out and available online. They are available in the JIMS Kalkaji website and applications are open. You will need to provide your exam details and fill it at the earliest after your exam scores have been released. You will also be required to make a 1200 admission fee payment as well.

faqs.question: Does JIMS Kalkaji accept CAT score?
faqs.answer: Yes, JIMS Kalkaji, Delhi accepts CAT as well as results from XAT, MAT, CMAT, ATMA for both courses in Management and Business. But the cutoff marks for each exam varies.  They accept a CAT, XAT or ATMA composite score of above 500 with atleast 50% graduation score. Now, it may vary each year but this was one of the frequently seen threshhold score for admission in JIMS Kalkaji

faqs.question: What are the minimum marks required for MBA at JIMS Kalkaji 2023?
faqs.answer: For MBA at JIMS Kalkaji which is one of the top Institute of Delhi approved by AICTE and has various rankings. It is also ranked as one of the top B- School. They are asking for minimum 50% marks in undergraduation from any background and 60 percentile in various good management exams such as CAT, XAT, MAT, AMTA with a decent score. If you score more than 60 percentile then you can also apply for scholarship programme offered by them.

review_summary.college_name: NIMS Institute of Management and Commerce Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Aviation Management - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty members are here. They prepare us for interviews and internships.

content.Placements: NIMS University provides 100% placements to students. Top companies like Google, Amazon, Indigo, Oyo, and Bajaj Finance visit the college for placements. The university also provides paid internships to students. Students got a job from companies like Oyo, etc., as a consultant manager, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are best here as they provide fully AC and furnished rooms to students. It provides 3 sharing rooms with 3 beds, 3 study tables, and 3 separate almirahs for students. It also provides Wi-Fi and a cold water filter for students. The hostel also contains a mess in which food is served to the students of the best quality.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: NIMS University is best fro MBA course.

content.Placements: Around 90% of students are placed. The highest salary package offered ranges from 15 LPA - 35 LPA and the lowest salary package offered ranges from 2 LPA- 9 LPA. Top companies are Google, Deloitte, Cognizant, and others. Marketing manager, financial manager, and other top positions are available.
content.Infrastructure: Our university infrastructure is first-rate. Its climate is healthy and natural. Students feel at ease in spacious classrooms. Each department has its library. Library has all of the top authors' reference books available. There are excellent labs with equipment available for medical students. There are 14 departments in all at NIMS.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it's a fine college with all facilities.

content.Placements: 80 out of 100 students get placed. The highest salary is 16 LPA, the lowest is 5 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. All management-related roles such as consulting, product management, sales and marketing, general management, and operations are considered (with salaries typically around 16 LPA). All students have done internships.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is quite good. The campus has its own playgrounds, auditorium, faculty building, and residential area, with a significant amount of greenery. Because of this greenery, one can often see peacocks and other animals and birds wandering throughout the campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Fashion Design and Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: NIMS is the best university, that you can visit.

content.Placements: NIMS University allows students who score at least 60 percent in senior secondary and gives scholarships to those who score more than 80 percent. The top companies for my course is D-decor and many textile industries, like cotton industry, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The building of the college is very good. NIMS provides projectors and the best quality seats in all the classes, as well as the lab in which we perform our textile projects and a machine lab for our stitching project. Hostels also have good infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: According to me, NIMS College is good. Good faculty and placements are provided.

content.Placements: 50% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 7 LPA and the lowest is 1 LPA. Many companies are available. 90% of students got internships, such as Manipal Hospital, Grow, AU Small Finance Bank, etc. Internships include roles like HR, marketing assistant, quality head, etc. Internships are a part of the MBA, and after the second semester, they are compulsory.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are present, like Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, and good infrastructure. Hostel facilities are good; food quality is also good. Medical facilities are also available because this is a medical college. For sports, a gym and basketball ground are present, and games like Spardha are organized by the college.

review_summary.college_name: Gautam Buddha University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with my college experience and recommend Gautam Buddha University for higher studies.

content.Placements: In my course, B.Tech in computer science and engineering, placements are decent and above average. In my batch, around 40-50 percent of students have received a PPO till now from the college placement drive. The average package offered is 6 LPA, and the highest package offered is around 12 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are TCS, Wipro, HCL, and Tech Mahindra. 70 percent of students got internships during the internship scheme. Full-stack web developer, software developer, and software engineer are the top roles offered by companies.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: This is a semi-government college.

content.Placements: Around 75 to 80 percent of students are placed in our course. The highest package offered in this course is 7 to 8 LPA, and the minimum package is 3 to 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies in this course include HCL, Wipro, TCS, and Cognizant. Around 60 to 70 percent of students get internships from our course in companies like Wipro and others. The top roles offered in this course are Software Developer and App Developer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is average. Wi-Fi does not work properly. Lab chairs are not comfortable. The library is nice, but the classrooms are not perfect. Hostels have all facilities like AC, Wi-Fi, and medical facilities. In sports, they focus on volleyball, while indoor games are not available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in English - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A decent college to have a good college life and a studious environment.

content.Placements: Since it's B.A. English course, we all know there are no placements for such a course. No companies come to hire students from the B.A. English course because it's obvious that it's a minor course. We don't wait for companies to come and give placements. If students want a placement, then they should join professional courses like B.Tech, B.Sc., etc.
content.Infrastructure: In terms of infrastructure, it is pretty great and better than other private colleges, while being a semi-government college. There is a LAN connection in a room for high-speed internet. The food is decent to eat, so it is easy to live and enjoy here.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com Hons.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of no internship.

content.Placements: No placement is provided by the university, they just provide some sort of internships, and no permanent placements are provided to us. All the students need to do a job on their own, and the GBU team don't even provide a way to earn. Some of their internships are also free.
content.Infrastructure: All the hostels and course infrastructure are well maintained, no doubt. Hostels are well-maintained. Mess food is also good, not like other hostels, all the food given is good enough to eat. The infrastructure for courses is also well maintained. All the buildings and classes are covered with centralised AC.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Reality of Gautam Buddha university.

content.Placements: There is a GBU-ET exam that this university conducts for admission, and you can also take admission through JEE Main percentile. In GBU-ET, they ask 30 questions of each Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry at a moderate level. Average package is approximately 4-5 LPA. There are some top recruiting companies like Wipro, etc. 30-40% students get on-campus jobs, others off-campus.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of college is very much nice. Classes are equipped with AC. There are separate rooms for each boy in hostel, which have a table, chair, and almari. There are water coolers in every hostel and building. There are also gym and sports building.

GBU also accepts direct admission to some of the programmes such as MTech, BCA, etc. It offers UG, PG, Doctoral and Diploma courses under various streams such as Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Applications, Biotechnology and Buddhist Studies. paragraphs: GBU Noida Admission 2025: Eligibility & Selection Criteria

GBU admission to the UG and PG courses is based on merit or entrance exam scores. The university considers national-level tests, but preference is given toGBU-ETcandidates. GBU-ET will be conducted at the various centres throughcomputer-based tests. The date will be published in advance before the examination. Besides, candidates also need to fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria for admission. The basic eligibility for UG courses is Class 12 whereas, graduation is required to apply for PG programmes. Below arepopular GBU coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Graduation in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST)

GBU feefor different programmes ranges between INR 20,000 and INR 10.8 lakh. The university provides 50% scholarships in tuition fees for students belonging to SC/ST categories. Also, GBU has the option to avail the relaxation of 50% of the fees for students securing more than 80% in Class 12 and admitted into BTech - Civil, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering. In any programme, the minimum number of students should be 15 or 50% of the total seat intake allocated to that programme. Students belonging to the Sport category can avail of the 5% relaxation in the respective qualifying examination. Gautam Buddha University admissions usually begin inApril. Generally, the GBU admission process includes steps including the registration process, merit list release, counselling, and admission fee payment. Candidates must start by applying for the course of their choice. Below are the steps to follow to get a seat in GBU Noida:
1. Application Process:

Candidates who wish to receive admission to GBU Noida must meet the course-specific eligibility criteria and pay the required application fee (INR 1,500 for General and INR 750 for SC/ ST candidates belonging to UP).
2. Selection:

Once the registration process is over, the university evaluates the applications of the candidates. The university selects candidates for most of the courses based on GBU-ET. It is a university entrance exam conducted for admission to MBA, BTech, PhD, etc. National or state-level entrance exams such asGATE, CLAT, JEE Main, etc. are also accepted for a few courses. For programmes such as BA, MA, MSc, MTech, etc., the admissions are based on merit in the last qualifying exam. The university releases the results ofGBU-ET online.
3. Admission Confirmation:

Selected candidates need to come for counselling and document verification. Aspirants need to bring the specified documents for verification. After the final selection is done, candidates need to pay a course fee to confirm their seats at the university.

placement_data.title: Gautam Buddha University Placement overview 2024
paragraphs: For Gautam Buddha University placements 2023, the he highest and average package was INR 24 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA . A total of 448 students registered for placements whereas 312 students were placed . M ore than 50 companies visited the campus during Gautam Buddha University placements 2023. The leading recruiters during Gautam Buddha University placements 2023 included Tekion India Private Limited, Freerechagre Axis Bank, and S&P Global.

Furthermore, the highest and average package offered during GBU University School of Management placements 2023 stood at INR 12 LPA and INR 5 LPA, respectively. Further, the placement rate recorded during University School of Management placements 2023 was 78% . Moreover, according to Gautam Buddha University Engineering and Management NIRF reports 2024, the median package offered during Gautam Buddha University BTech and MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 4.5 LPA and INR 4.05 LPA , respectively.

There is a separate indoor stadium for badminton, and other indoor sports are also available. Hostel provides single non-sharing and personal rooms with 24x7 electricity and internet connection through LAN. Mess food quality is good and hy...

reviews.review_heading: This is a semi-government college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is average. Wi-Fi does not work properly. Lab chairs are not comfortable. The library is nice, but the classrooms are not perfect. Hostels have all facilities like AC, Wi-Fi, and medical facilities. In sports, they focus on volleyball, while indoor games are not available.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college to have a good college life and a studious environment.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, it is pretty great and better than other private colleges, while being a semi-government college. There is a LAN connection in a room for high-speed internet. The food is decent to eat, so it is easy to live and enjoy here.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of no internship.
reviews.review_text: All the hostels and course infrastructure are well maintained, no doubt. Hostels are well-maintained. Mess food is also good, not like other hostels, all the food given is good enough to eat. The infrastructure for courses is also well maintained. All the buildings and classes are covered with centralised AC.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of Gautam Buddha university.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is very much nice. Classes are equipped with AC. There are separate rooms for each boy in hostel, which have a table, chair, and almari. There are water coolers in every hostel and building. There are also gym and sports building.

overview_faqs.question: What documents are required for the refund process at SRM Ramapuram?
overview_faqs.answer: The fee refund process at SRM Ramapuram only begins upon receipt of the original documents by the Director of Admissions, Amaravati, either by courier or in person. Following is the list of the required documents:All receipts for fee paymentsCounselling call letterProvisional allotment letter (PAL)Cancelled cheque from the bank for money refund.Note: If all documents submitted for refund are in order, then the time taken to process and effect the transfer of refund money will be 30 working days.

overview_faqs.question: Does SRM Ramapuram have any fee refund policy?
overview_faqs.answer: SRM Ramapuram fee refund policy is based on UGC guidelines. Candidates get full refund at any time between the academic year of admission. To get the refund, candidates are required to bring an application form signed by the student and their parent and can be submitted in person or online. Candidates get refund to their bank provided in the refund request form. The refund will be processed by RTGS or NEFT.

content.Placements: Placements for B. Tech IT at SRM RMP are around 60–75 percent. Almost everyone manages to secure placements. Top recruiters are TCS, Accenture, Infosys, Cognizant, and similar MNCs.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure at SRM RMP is reliable on campus. Admin and academic blocks are well-maintained. Classrooms are clean. Sports facilities exist but are limited.

Many events take place throughout the year, be it hack fests or other co-curricular fests.

reviews.review_heading: Students may have some problems as the food is most of the time South Indian cuisine.

admission_overview.college_name: Gitarattan International Business School Admission 2025: Eligibility, Fee, Application & Selection

paragraphs: GIBS admissionsare entrance-based. The institute considers CAT, MAT, CLAT, CET, etc. scores for admission to specific programmes.GIBS Delhioffers courses at UG and PG levels in Business and Law streams in affiliation withGGSIPU. The programmes include MBA, BBA, BA LLB, BBA LLB and LLM. Interested candidates can fill out a form on the official website of GGSIPU for admission.

Gitarattan International Business School offers admission based on national or university-level entrance exams. Aspirants also have to meet the eligibility requirements to apply for admission. Below areGIBS Delhi coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

GIBS offers admission after considering the merit and entrance exam scores of the candidates. The reservation policy of Government of NCT of Delhi is applied for allocation of seats to various categories. Below are the steps to get a seat in GIBS Delhi:
Step 1: GIBS Delhi Application Process 2025

Aspirants meeting the eligibility criteria have to fill out the form available on the official website of GGSIPU. Candidates can apply under CET and Non-CET courses as required for the preferred programme. Aspirants have to further fill out the preference sheet available on the official website of GGSIPU.
Step 2: Selection

The institute selects candidates based on entrance exam scores. GIBS considers CAT, CMAT or IPU CET for MBA and CLAT for BA LLB (Hons) and BBA LLB (Hons) programmes. Admission to LLM and BBA is based on CLAT-PG and IPU CET, respectively.
Step 3: Counselling & Seat Allotment

Once selected, aspirants have to register for GGSIPU Counselling. Candidates are offered seat based on their entrance exam rank and choice-filling. Further, candidates have to report to the college and connect with GIBS. Shortlisted aspirants have to pay theGIBS Delhi feeto confirm their seats in the institute.

faqs.question: Q: What all courses are offered at EIILM Kolkata?

Further, the institute is affiliated withMAKAUTandVidyasagar University.The institute also offers nine courses in various streams such as IT & Software, Business and Management etc. EIILM-Kolkata offers merit-based scholarships for meritious and deserving students.

EIILM admission process is a multi-step process inclusive of application, appearance in the selection rounds, offline admission process, and document verification. A step-by-step process that students need to follow is as follows:

The registration fee for all programmes varies as per the counselling bodies & official website of EIILM Kolkata.
STEP 2: EIILM Kolkata Selection Process 2025

The IBS Gurgaon MBA or PGPM is its flagship course and is extended at the PG level for a duration of two-years. The PGPM course that provides a broad perspective on all areas of Management. In addition to this approach, IBS Gurgaon (ICFAI Gurugram) also offers a 14-week Summer Internship Program (SIP) to the students as a part of its PGPM course that offers real-time exposure to the students.
The ICFAI Gurgaon Business School programme equips students with various managerial competencies and leadership characteristics so that students can succeed in an increasingly complex and dynamic business environment. With the IBS Gurgaon MBA fees structure consisting of tuition fees, admission fees, security deposit, examination fees, etc. the IBS Gurgaon fees for MBA / PGPM comes to INR 9.09 Lakhs.

admission_overview.description: ICFAI Business School (IBS) Gurgaon admission 2026 is completely based on IBSAT, an online aptitude test. IBS Gurgaon offers a two-year, full-time PGPM programme to students. IBS Gurgaon also offers scholarships to meritorious students. Those candidates who have attempted GMAT/XAT/CAT/NMAT entrance exam are excused from giving the IBSAT exam and will be considered for admission on the basis of their rank/score in any one exam.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for the PGPM programme at IBS Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: PGPM programme at IBS Gurgaon demands graduation in any stream with 50% and above marks and English medium of instruction. Candidates should have completed 15 years of education. Candidates who do not have English medium in graduation have to send TOEFL, NELT, or IELTS scores till May 31,  2026. Final-year students are also eligible, subject to completion of all graduation requirements within the given time frame.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to the PGPM programme at IBS Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: To take admission, aspirants have to appear for IBSAT 2025 or submit legitimate scores of GMAT, CAT, NMAT, or XAT. IBSAT is a computer-based two-hour entry test organized by The ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education. Aspirants who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to the selection process in February 2026. Final selection is ascertained on the basis of micro presentation, personal interview, and past academic record.

faqs.question: Can I apply for the PGPM programme at IBS Gurgaon in my final year of graduation?
faqs.answer: Yes, final-year graduation students are eligible for the PGPM course in IBS Gurgaon. They should complete all degree criteria by 31st May 2026 and furnish the graduation proof on or before 1st November 2026. Admission will be provisional until the documents are received. It is the responsibility of the candidate to meet the eligibility criteria well in time.

faqs.question: Does IBS Gurgaon accepts entrance exams other than IBSAT for PGPM admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, IBS Gurgaon also accepts GMAT, CAT, NMAT by GMAC, and XAT scores from 2023 onwards in lieu of IBSAT 2025. The candidates with these scores may proceed to the selection process if they meet other criteria. Selection involves micro presentation, personal interview, and academic performance assessment. Selection briefings are also conducted to guide the candidates.

faqs.question: What specialisations are offered in the IBS Gurgaon PhD programme?
faqs.answer: IBS Gurgaon provides a full-time PhD in Management with specializations in Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Human Resource Management. It also has a standalone PhD in Economics. The course curriculum is for a career in teaching, research, and consultancy. Both theoretical and practical exposure is provided to the students during the course.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to the IBS Gurgaon PhD programme?
faqs.answer: The IBS Gurgaon PhD course has a selection process that involves IBSAT 2025 scores or scores of GMAT, CAT, NMAT or XAT examinations.Those exempted are alumni of IFHE, graduates of the MPhil programme and UGC NET qualified students.Suitable candidates are required to fulfill the prescribed academic requirements for the relevant specialisation. The process involves application, entrance qualification, and final selection.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at IBS Gurgaon without an entrance exam?
faqs.answer: No, IBS Gurgaon does not provide admission without an entrance test. Candidates either take IBSAT or provide valid CAT, GMAT, or NMAT scores. Even with these scores, they have to appear for the Micro Presentation and Personal Interview for selection.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at IBS Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: No, IBS Gurgaon does not provide direct admissions. All the candidates need to qualify through IBSAT, CAT, GMAT, or NMAT. The selection procedure also involves Micro Presentation and Personal Interview prior to final confirmation.

Else, they can also submit their scores of other entrance exams at the time of filling the application form. Aspirants must also pay an application fee of INR 1,800 via Credit/ Debit Card or Net-banking.Selection Rounds:Admission to Management courses at IBS Gurgaon is entirely entrance-based. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their past academic records and valid scores in either IBSAT or GMAT/CAT/ XAT/ NMAT by GMAC with a valid score. faqs.question: What is the last date for admissions to MBA course at IBS Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: The last admission dates (LAD) for applying to the PGPM course at IBS Gurgaon, students can apply from July to February. Thus, the deadlines for applying to the course always lie in the month of February. Also, IBSAT is usually conducted in the last week of December and the results are also released on December's last date.

reviews.review_heading: Review of ICFAI Business School (IBS), Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of IBS Gurgaon isn't much good. The building is quite old, and renovation can be a suggestion. The facilities provided inside the classrooms are quite good. High-range Wi-Fi, air-conditioning, library, and a computer lab with all facilities are available. IBS Gurgaon does not have any hostel facilities within the campus but provides contact details of good PGs and flats near the college for the out-stationed students.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college in terms of placements.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available like parking, canteen, Wi-Fi, and air-conditioner classes with playing areas indoor and outdoor both. Even there doesn't medical facilities and sports and games have also taken place as they are different events taking place between different departments, and the quality facilities are not a labeling workout but it is available in IBS Hyderabad.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college, best ROI.
reviews.review_text: As of IBS Gurgaon, there is no hostel facility although numerous flats and PGs are located close to college. The canteen is quite good and affordable for students. Students can engage into numerous sports like badminton and table tennis to release stress.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good ROI.
reviews.review_text: Our batch has started in COVID time, and I do not know much about the infrastructure of the college. The college does not have a hostel facility, but the students can find accommodations near the college very easily, like PG, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is worth taking admission for PGPM.
reviews.review_text: The quality of facilities in the hostel is great, and the food quality is good. It feels like home there. Medical facilities are auspicious for a person living there. All the sports have been taken care of in the college like football, tennis etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and average infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average, and the campus is a rented property and is not too big. The canteen is available on the campus with reasonable rates. Classrooms are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi is also available on the campus. Talking about sports, a small badminton court is available, and a cricket area is available. A parking area is also available for students coming in their own vehicles.

reviews.review_heading: Poor placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: One disadvantage of the college is that the infrastructure of the college is not good. College campus is little and too old. Apart from this, other facilities ie. Wi-fi, computer labs and library are well maintained and are in good condition. Food provided in the canteen is also good quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, must take admission.
reviews.review_text: Overall infrastructure is very good. Only disadvantage is that they have small college campus, no college does nor provide hostel facilities but there are many PGs available near college. All the facilities like wi-fi, computer labs, libraries are available and are in very good condition. Food available in canteen is also tasty and sports is one of the important element of college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides poor placements for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college does not provide hostel facility. Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, spacious classrooms, well-equipped lab and libraries. Quality of the food served in the college canteen is good. Every year sports meet is organised at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with college.
reviews.review_text: College does not provide hostel facilities. Even they do not provide any assistance in finding a PG nearby. College campus is very small. There are two libraries in the college, which has all the relevant books regarding all the subjects. All the other facilities are also average.

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure and no college life.
reviews.review_text: There are no campus life and college campus is small. As well as there is hardly a play ground in the college. Moreover, college does not have hostel facilities. You have to take PG. The good thing is there are all the relevant books available and Wi-Fi is also available. Classrooms are good and food available in the canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college offers good placements but no campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our college does not provide hostel facility. But near the college, there are many PGs available. I also opted for PG. Campus life is not so good, and the college is small. Classrooms are clean and spacious as well as air-conditioned. There are two libraries and Wi-Fi available.

reviews.review_heading: 100% students got placed during SIP. Training workshops and guest lectures organized every week.
reviews.review_text: As the college don't provide hostel facility which is the biggest drawback and talking of the infrastructure of the college it is quite decent from study point of view as it has good library setup and lab too but they don't allow good Wi-Fi in campus and also campus is very small as compared to another B school and also no proper playground or student activity room available in college.

reviews.review_heading: Good college to spend your precious 2 years.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in average, but the college campus is fully air conditioned and Wi-Fi equipped. The classrooms do have online/digital learning platform. The library has very famous case studies written by IBS. There is a small but hygienic cafeteria as well.

reviews.review_heading: IBS journey full of memories for life.
reviews.review_text: The campus is located in the middle of city surrounded by corporate world around. The classrooms are well-equipped with air conditioning and modern online learning platforms. The library has all books and am amazing collection of case studies (for which IBS is known for). The campus has a very amazing life inside.

reviews.review_heading: Don't you want to experience vibrant campus with excellent academics if you want, join Kumaraguru.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is awesome. This college gets an A+ in NAAC accreditation. Our campus has neat and clean infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available. Hostel is safe and secure, and only veg food is provided. Our campus is pet-friendly. Library is big and books are also available. Classrooms are perfect.

reviews.review_heading: Kumaraguru College of Technology is absolutely the best Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Kumaraguru College of Technology has more than 20 courses. It had more spacious classrooms, more laboratories, and free Wi-Fi network facilities available in the college. This college had the biggest auditorium. The library was also there in the college. The college hostel and canteen food quality were very hygienic and healthy. Multiple sports ground facilities were also available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I like the college. It is a very nice college.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very good and pleasant. The rooms in a hostel are very and the wardens are very friendly. Good campus life. The facilities are very good. We have well well-organized library. The hostel is very clean and peaceful. Hostel foods are hygienic and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Great academics and vibrant campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities for the ECE department are modern labs like VLSI, IoT, embedded systems, well-equipped classrooms,  24x7 Wi-Fi, and a vast library with updated resources. Hostel have comfortable rooms, good hygiene, and a study-friendly ambiance. Mess and canteen serves decent food quality with varieties. The canteen offers snacks and beverages. There is an on-campus clinic with basic medical services. There are excellent facilities for indoor and outdoor games, a gym, and regular sports events.

reviews.review_heading: KCT - Insight by middle bencher.
reviews.review_text: It has well-equipped infrastructure with library and labs. It is a Wi-Fi enabled campus covering all areas. Hostel food is good compared to other colleges. Other than hostel and mess, the campus has cafes like Kore, Namma Cafe, East Kore, and KS Cafe. Medical facilities are available 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: Good choice. Nice faculty members.
reviews.review_text:
Awesome Ambiance: The hostel block is surrounded by a lot of trees, and it gives a good feeling of being around nature. So, any nature lovers, you are sure to be pleased.
Food: It is usual to say bad things about hostel food, but KCT hostels provide quality food with good taste.

Food and snacks at hostel are good and medical facilities are available 24/7. Regarding sports and games, we have good tutors and teamwork and achieved many prizes.

reviews.review_heading: Very satisfied, very low fee collected compared to other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely fit for you if you got a 6,000-8,000 rank in EAMCET.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided for every classroom, which is a private network, and a hostel is not available for this college as it is located in the centre of the city. The library is good, the labs are good, and the classrooms are very nice, you will feel like you are sitting in a round table discussion.

reviews.review_heading: A place where coding begins from the beginning.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility, so we can live in nearby PGs. The canteen food is very good, especially the idly sambar. Everybody needs their own laptops, as they want everyone to do hands-on projects, not only during lab time. This is really helpful because it helps us grow from the first year itself.

reviews.review_heading: If you comprise campus life, you can join this college.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel for KMIT, and there is no college bus for KMIT. You should travel on your own, and if you are far, you should stay in private hostels which are near the campus. Some are good and some are really bad hostels. Canteen food is quite good and there is no non veg in canteen. You can order from outside, the price of canteen is reasonable, not too costly.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges for CSE with excellent placements and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: KMIT is a neat and updated campus that remains well-maintained. It contains all the essentials required for pursuing an engineering course. Classrooms are projector-enabled, with comfortable seating and proper ventilation. Laboratories are fully equipped with new computers and good internet connectivity. Thus, coding and projects can be managed easily. The library is sufficiently spacious, filled with lots of books, helpful references, and space to read quietly. Wi-Fi connectivity extends throug...

reviews.review_heading: If you are interested in coding, this college helps you a lot.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure has developed as compared to when I joined the college three years ago, quite good infrastructure. For every course, there is infrastructure available. There is no hostel, only a canteen. Canteen is pure veg; it provides decent food at low prices, quality is good, and the faculty also eat there. Medical facility, I am unaware of. Sports and games are less prioritized in KMIT, but if you are a professional or play a good game, you will be encouraged to participate in tournaments, n...

reviews.review_heading: The college focuses on creativity, spirit, knowledge building, ethics, and performance in students.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are moderate. I would rate them as 7 out of 10. They provide everything, including college systems. There is no hostel for this college. But the food is of better quality. I would rate it 4.5 out of 5. Sports and games, they won't show much interest in that. But those who are interested can participate.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied and college life. Everything is strict. They doesn't have hostel so disturbing.
reviews.review_text: I can say that some of my facilities are good and others are too bad that they have certain knowledge about the subject but they can't explain properly. The infrastructure is bad. The computers are not working well. They have so many kinds of rules against it. It is a big problem in my college that there is no hostel kind of thing in college. College is not so big. In canteen, they don't even feed non-veg. I want to say build a proper hostel to maintain the college.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with the faculty but it has decent and good placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a decent and neat infrastructure but it is not that equipped. It provides decent qualities of systems and equipments like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library. Our college has no hostel facility since it is in the middle of the city. It does not have much space, and it also has transport facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college and has fabulous faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is awesome. Classrooms are in good condition, and the computer labs are in good condition with Wi-Fi connectivity. The library is big, and there are many books. The hostel facilities are separate hostels for boys and girls. The sports facilities are good. There is a canteen where you can buy some snacks.

reviews.review_heading: KMIT - A perfect blend of learning, opportunities, and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent infrastructure and facilities that support both academic and co-curricular development. Library is well stocked with textbooks and reference materials which help the students in studying. The classrooms are equipped with projectors.

reviews.review_heading: Strong placements, modern labs, and great exposure for IT students at KMIT.
reviews.review_text: IT department has well-equipped labs with high-speed internet, modern systems, and access to platforms like GitHub and AWS educated. Classrooms are clean, air-conditioned, and have smart boards. The library is spacious with a good collection of tech books and journals.

reviews.review_heading: Best for those who are interested in coding, and college will support self learning.
reviews.review_text: Labs are being upgraded, and every system works fine. Wi-Fi is not available. Classrooms are also quite good. If you are top student, you get a nice classroom. Sports and games are less. Canteen is small and food is average. There is no hostel on campus and no bus to campus. Private hostels are available near college, but they are not good enough.

reviews.review_heading: My review of the Keshav Memorial.
reviews.review_text: College does not provide hostel facilities, but near college, there are many private hostels. Coming to infrastructure, it can be considered moderate. College provides canteen facilities, and the food is slightly better. College does not support playing sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: A college that provides good opportunities for coders, but is definitely behind in terms of campus.
reviews.review_text: College provides its own wi-fi that connect only to the lab equipment, while it does not provide internet in general. The labs are adequate, we observed issues with the systems from time to time. Classrooms are average since the building is quite old, however there is a projector facility arranged in many classrooms. Library is somewhat small for a college of such reputation, wish there were more collections of technical books apart from the same old. There is no hostel facility in our campus al...

reviews.review_heading: My personal experience at KMIT.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel facility in our college, as it is located in the center of the city, Narayanguda. There are many hostels near the college for the students who hail from other towns or cities. College has an above average infrastructure with a good amount of labs and available Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.review_title: Life at RV University and the student life.

reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with education like teaching, placements, and all over it's good.

review_content.Placements: Above 75% of students are taken for admission. Maximum 1,75,000 is the free structure. Students went to good places for placement, and we can become a criminologist or forensic expert. Those who completed all the subjects are allowed to internships, that's it.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have good classroom. Wi-Fi connection and lab facilities are available. There is a hospital inside the college for any emergency. We have two good canteens for lunch. There are lots of clubs for individual fields like sports, dance, singing, etc. There is a good hostel facility with basic needs and all.

facilities: Option to choose electives from School of Liberal Arts & Scienc

reviews.review_heading: Good college in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Good classrooms with AC, Wi-Fi, and library by Brigade Groups. Good infrastructure facilities with sports and games, and the canteen is well maintained and has lots of options. Dispensary is available with medications. Overall a good college to choose from.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely a waste of money, time, and energy.
reviews.review_text: The quality of Wi-Fi has improved recently, and before, it was quite poor. Labs are open to students now, and I do not have much information on labs. Classrooms are pretty decent. The library is pretty good, especially after the construction of the new library. The canteen is good, and the food is the worst. Sports are there just for the namesake. Medical facilities are pretty good.

reviews.review_heading: Decent enough college for studio guys with good campus life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. As it is a new college, infrastructure is also great. Wi-Fi is pretty decent. Classrooms are comfortable and library is the best part of college. Sports ground is shared with RVCE and in total it is worth as a place to chill and enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: Life at RV University and the student life.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi in every corner of the campus. Labs are well-equipped. We have a top-class library. I don't know much about the hostel because I am from Bangalore. I have heard from my friends that the food is good in hostel. For sports and games, we have a proper ground.

reviews.review_heading: I have a problem with attendance. Placements are the best.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice but they are constructing more. Wi-Fi and classrooms are top-notch. They have a big library, which is good. The food in the canteen is good we have MM Foods, as well as both small and large Mingos. I don't know much about sports. Games are good, we play treasure hunts, escape rooms, and all events.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with education like teaching, placements, and all over it's good.
reviews.review_text: We have good classroom. Wi-Fi connection and lab facilities are available. There is a hospital inside the college for any emergency. We have two good canteens for lunch. There are lots of clubs for individual fields like sports, dance, singing, etc. There is a good hostel facility with basic needs and all.

reviews.review_heading: Impressive but need more improvement .
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for our course is really good, no issues with the Wi-Fi, labs are well-equipped, classrooms are clean, we have huge library in the campus which has been opened recently. When it comes to hostel facilities, Little improvement of food is required and other amenities like washing machines gym and all are provided there is a parking space for hostlers separately if they have vehicle.

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing. I recommend everyone to join this college.
reviews.review_text: College provides good Wi-Fi speed, and classrooms are well-maintained and hygienic. New library has opened recently in RVU is very fantastic. Hostel facilities are amazing, to be honest. The quality of the food is decent. Canteen food is excellent.

reviews.review_heading: Pretty much not satisfied because of the timings and not fests and interactive things in 2024.
reviews.review_text: Our has good infrastructure and they are still building so many blocks for different departments. The newest thing is the rvu library it's one of the main monument of rvu. The facalties are very good and interactive with the students. The canteen has good food.

reviews.review_heading: RV University isn't too bad of place to join. It's really shaping up.
reviews.review_text: Each classroom has a smart board, and if no smart board, we have a smart projector. We recently got a new library, and I've never been so happy; it's absolutely massive, and we have privacy booths inside too. It's really nice. I'm not in the hostel, so I'm not sure, but I haven't heard great things from my friends.

reviews.review_heading: Yet to be satisfied with the greenery on campus.
reviews.review_text: If we come to the infrastructure of the college, it is an under-construction building as it is new. The management is now planning to build a variety of buildings for different courses separately, and there are Wi-Fi facilities, labs, and a beautiful library for us to read.

reviews.review_heading: RV University from the POV of a Student of RVU.
reviews.review_text: Well, some buildings for RVU are still under construction, but the ones that are done are extremely modern and cool. I'm not a part of the hostel, but I've heard from my friends who are that the rooms are really great, but the food quality is kind of okay-ish.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the RV University.
reviews.review_text: Half of the building is under construction, but classrooms are not bad, and they will be renovated later. There is Wi-Fi everywhere in the building. There was no vacancy in the hostel (150+ girls on the waiting list), so I had to look for PG accommodation. Canteen is a bit far from our course building, but the food is good. They have a health center on campus. The college has a ground, and they conduct sports day and encourage us to participate in student club activities as well.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and faculty are good, and students have to catch up on things along with it.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and everything are good. The library is small. The new building for the library will be soon available. There are 2-3 hostels. Some hostels' maintenance is good. The food is average. Some hostels' food is good. The maintenance is average. One hostel is good, but it is outside of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The best place if you want to go to a college with a lot of facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have a top-class library, so accommodating and comfortable. The facilities are a 4/5 since there's more construction happening. The hostel medical facilities are great, and so is sports; we have one event happen every year. Most of the events are hosted by the clubs. It's very enjoyable and fun.

GD Goenka University comprises more than 9 constituent schools and departments, including the School of Engineering & Sciences, the School of Management, and the School of Liberal Arts, among others. These schools offer a wide range of courses at the UG, PG, and PhD levels, across various streams. MBA and BTech are among the most popular programmes offered at the university.
GD Goenka University Gurugram offers a full-time, two-year MBA programme at the PG level. The MBA programme offered at the university covers core courses in the areas of Marketing, HR, International Business, etc. during the first year. While in the second year, the university offers various major and minor specialisation options to students. Students also have the option to pursue their MBA degree with an additional specialisation in either Fintech or Business Analytics.
The BTech programme offered by GD Goenka University is a four-year programme. It is offered in several specialisations, including Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Electronics & Communication Engineering, among others. reviews_list.review_title: I am very glad to take admission in such a good university.

review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the building is well-built and of high-quality labs. Classrooms are digital. Library is very well furnished, and all books are available here. The quality of hostel is like a 5 star hostel, and medical facilities are also available. Food quality at hostel is very excellent.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Pharma. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: GD Goenka University is a good private college recognized by UGC, BCI, ICAR, PCI, and NAAC.

review_content.Placements: About 70% to 80% of students in our M.Pharm course get placed. The highest package is 18–20 LPA, the lowest is 3–7 LPA, and the average is 10–12 LPA. Recruiting companies include Medanta, Sun Pharma, Fortis, GRC Healthcare, and others. Around 80% of students get internships at Sun Pharma, like Regulatory Affairs and QA/QC.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, pharmaceutical labs, library, CIL labs, machine room, gym, cafeteria, swimming pool, football ground, archery room, badminton rooms, table tennis court, lawn tennis court, pool room, steam and spa rooms are all available. The quality of the food is amazing. There is centralized AC, a study room, a common room, a fridge, Wi-Fi, a smart TV, and hygienic washrooms in every room. Medical facilities are available 24/7.

reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with it. Students must visit the university.

review_content.Placements: Around 70-80% of students get placements. The package offered is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Lenskart and Indira Gandhi Eye Hospital. 100% of students got internships from Indira Gandhi Eye Hospital, Dayal Eye Centre, and Ahooja Eye Hospital. It has all facilities in the hostel like Wi-Fi, mess food, and all these things are very good.

paragraphs: GD Goenka University admissionsare entrance-based for the majority of the programmes. Students who are interested in taking admission for at GD Goenka University can check the points mentioned below:

The admission process starts with filling GD Goenka University application form. Interested candidates can visit the official website to apply for the course of their choice along with making the fee payment of INR 1,100 for all courses.
2. Selection Process
For MBA courses candidates need to clear CAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ CUET/GD Goenka Test and fulfil of latest eligibility, i.e., class 12. However, for the BTech programme, students need to clear JEE (Main).
3. Admission Confirmation

faqs.question: Is it hard to get admission to GD Goenka University?
faqs.answer: GD Goenka University admission to a majority of undergraduate and postgraduate courses is based on marks scored in Goenkan Aptitude Test for Admission (GATA) followed by Personal Interview (PI) round. Other national-level entrance exams accepted include CUET, CUET-PG, JEE Main, MAT, UID Design Aptitude Test, etc. For candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria and who have prepared well, it is not hard to get admission at GD Goenka University.

reviews.review_heading: I am very glad to take admission in such a good university.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the building is well-built and of high-quality labs. Classrooms are digital. Library is very well furnished, and all books are available here. The quality of hostel is like a 5 star hostel, and medical facilities are also available. Food quality at hostel is very excellent.

reviews.review_heading: GD Goenka University is a good private college recognized by UGC, BCI, ICAR, PCI, and NAAC.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, pharmaceutical labs, library, CIL labs, machine room, gym, cafeteria, swimming pool, football ground, archery room, badminton rooms, table tennis court, lawn tennis court, pool room, steam and spa rooms are all available. The quality of the food is amazing. There is centralized AC, a study room, a common room, a fridge, Wi-Fi, a smart TV, and hygienic washrooms in every room. Medical facilities are available 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with it. Students must visit the university.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available for students like a peaceful library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms. The infrastructure is very attractive and unique from other universities. The hostel is similar to the classroom building. It has all facilities in the hostel like Wi-Fi, mess food, and all these things are very good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members were good. The library was well-maintained, and medical facilities were also good. Sports facilities were also good. You could participate in any co-curricular activities, as all were conducted by the university. The university environment was good for improving your personal growth.

reviews.review_heading: The facility is good, the environment, and facilities are good. All is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, and library are good. Food is mostly North Indian, somewhat nice, and desserts are really tasty. All facilities are excellent. Wi-Fi provides personal access, and daily cleaning of rooms and washrooms, It provides good service in a hostel-like, home-environment.

reviews.review_heading: Good value for money and good environment.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good on our campus. There's a stationary, a cafe, a supermarket, and a canteen. Also, each and every classroom has AC and a projector. The hostel is good, with mess food being far better than many other hostel foods. Every hostel room also has a study room for students to study.

reviews.review_heading: Taking admission in GD should know all the information that is given in this article.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, libraries, and other areas are fully functional. We have good infrastructure. The food is amazing at the college. We have different options for food. The hostel people also have snacks and varieties to have so they don't feel sick.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to see your future, you can join GD Goenka.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my course is the best, I feel, because in a proper way they have planned it, and from the second year, they are giving us the opportunity to try for an internship. The classroom is in the proper manner, and there are two labs in my university. If we talk about the hostel, they are also in a proper way.

reviews.review_heading: It is an average college for B.Tech or any other course. It is just like other private colleges.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure  is really good. There is a fully AC campus. Library, labs, and classrooms are well-maintained with Wi-Fi. There are refreshment areas like Domino's, Nescafe, CCD, Fuel Zap, Nirulas, and college canteens on the campus. Hostel is like a 4-star hotel with all facilities like fully AC, swimming pool, gym, shooting range, and many more. But hostel is quite expensive 2.5 lakhs for 4 sharing rooms and 1.5 lakhs for 8 sharing.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good college for the degree.
reviews.review_text: So the infrastructure of my college was so good; there were hostel facilities available for both girls and boys, and it was the best in the Delhi NCR. The mess was so good and had facilities for the gym and ground sports. Overall, it was very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by United World Institute of Design, GD Goenka UniversityReviewed on 2 Jul 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and management of this college.
reviews.review_text: UID has really good infrastructure and facilities for the students. All kinds of modern facilities were available for the students interactive learning. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports, etc. Facilities were given to the students. Mess and canteen food were good to eat. All the facilities are properly managed by the college management.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include multiple sports fields, indoor sports facilities, the availability of coaching, auditoriums, amphitheaters, air-conditioned lecture halls and well-stocked libraries. The campus is huge and has many popular eateries and spots to hang out with your friends.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and average placements.
reviews.review_text: Each block of the university has its own air-conditioned spacious library with a good collection of books. The classrooms are also air conditioned. There are clean washrooms, good sports facilities, hygienic canteen and an overall green campus. The quality of food available in the mess as well as canteen is also satisfactory. The infrastructure and facilities that the university provides is worth the feels charge by them.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GD Goenka University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure provided by our college are so good that we have a very big classroom with good Wi-Fi. Our hostel also has good food for students and no complaints have been reported by the students based on the quality of our food. Our hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: Happy to have this college.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms in GD Goenka university are very much good and the infrastructure is very nice, all the classes have proper light, fans, AC rooms and all class have one or two projectors. Wi-Fi is available all the time and labs are also working and in good condition and students can access them any time whenever they want to use. There are two libraries in our college and every students can access both of them. And there is a huge collection of books. In hostel every rooms have AC, fridge, oven ...

You don’t need to worry about space, teacher support, or anything in the college. If you need support at any point, contact any teacher or senior, everyone is very supportive.

reviews.review_text: The classrooms are airy, clean, and have very good furniture. Projectors are also present in each and every class for better learning. The library is also good as expected, with a lot of study material, a good staff, and a very disciplined environment. Now, talking about the canteen, the food is top-class and has various options with a good environment. A sports week is also held every year with almost every possible game, including indoor and outdoor ones. The hostels are also good with a clean...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best university with the best staff and nature. The environment is  good.

The library is available, and almost every book is accessible there. The hostel is clean and well-maintained, with a gym and additional amenities. Sports facilities are available at our university. Every year, an inter-university sports meet is held.

reviews.review_text: Washrooms are dirty and not cleaned properly. No transport facilities. The projector for smart classes does not work properly. reviews.review_heading: The college provides good placements and teachers are knowledgeable.
reviews.review_text: The quality of classrooms, labs, libraries, hostels, and sports facilities, as well as the availability of Wi-Fi and other amenities, is good. Classrooms are spacious, well-maintained, and equipped with advanced technology. Hostels offer decent rooms and good food.

reviews.review_heading: College is amazing. You will learn so many things from here as well you will enjoy the events.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing. Labs are amazing. I am learning so many things from labs. The library is also beneficial for us. Classroom with smart TV is available on our campus which helps us to understand clearly through visuality. It will be beneficial.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is good with experienced, good, and helpful teachers.
reviews.review_text: The Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA) department is equipped with well-furnished classrooms featuring smart boards, good Wi-Fi access, and seminar halls for presentations and guest lectures. The college also has a library with a wide range of business-related books, and computer labs with excellent internet facilities are available. Hostel accommodations are decent, with clean rooms. The mess provides hygienic food with a balanced diet, while the canteen offers snacks and meals at afford...

reviews.review_heading: The college is average. There is a fine infrastructure, but the placements are not good enough.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and nice. During the NAAC visit, the college looked very beautiful and well-structured. There are projectors in every class, and I have been to the computer lab only, so half of the computers are not working. I don't stay in the hostel, but the canteen food is okay. According to me, hygiene is maintained, and the washrooms are pretty well too. They just need to provide sanitary napkins for girls.

reviews.review_heading: College has the best facilities.
reviews.review_text: The main facility is our campus is too big or sufficient for students. University has its hospital, so students can get good information about their course and there is also good sports culture. There are smart classrooms for students so they can learn or understand easily.

reviews.review_heading: This university has a lot of good education which you won't find anywhere else.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and library facilities are available in good condition and parking. There is a lot of space in it. Medical facilities are very good in which medicine and different kinds of things are used. There is also a ground for playing.

reviews.review_heading: Shri Guru Ram Rai University is a great college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and canteen are available and they have the best service. Every department has different buildings. It has neat and clean classrooms with smart TVs and good infrastructure, including fans, blackboard, good desks, and chairs for students.

reviews.review_heading: NAAC inspection made the university make changes in it.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is now the most impressive thing in the university as it is focusing more on the ambiance and a home-like environment for the students. The food provided is also good in the hostel and canteens, plus the sports facilities have also been provided to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SGRR University.
reviews.review_text: The college provides the best education and one of the best facilities all over Dehradun. The infrastructure quality is impressive. The college provides free Wi-Fi to all the students, which has no limit to use. The classrooms and labs are neat, clean, and fully comfortable. The library is also available for students, in which the seating arrangements are very impressive with a peaceful environment.

reviews.review_heading: Shri Guru Ram Rai University.
reviews.review_text: This course is one of the best courses in the medical field. There are many scopes for this course. The hostel is compulsory for nursing students as there are night shifts or late-night work to provide safety to the students. The hostel is well-maintained and near to the college.

reviews.review_heading: Get the professional course of Journalism, B.A. Mass Communications.
reviews.review_text: No doubt, our faculty members are very polite and supportive, comparatively. They are familiar with us and always try to make us feel comfortable. However, they don't have sufficient knowledge of new media tools and technology, and the software used to work in media houses. The college infrastructure is just okay. There is a mini media lab, but Wi-Fi facility is not available.
