review_summary.college_name: ABES Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with college as it has decent placement and great faculty.

content.Placements: Placement of the CSE batch is around 90 percent, and the highest package goes to 59 LPA. There is a good thing about ABES, which is that in the college, the placements are taken by AIML students of AI students, so ABES has a decent placement rate in 2025.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not good in the hostel, but it is okay labs and classrooms are fully AC, and labs are also good. The mess food and canteen are also good, though the canteen is a little bit expensive, but it is still good, and the mess food is also not that bad. So, in all we can say that the mess food and canteen service are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It's a good, or we can say decent, college.

content.Placements: Total 1080 numbers of students were enrolled in B.Tech CSE last year. The placement was decent, approximately 60% placed in good packages above 3.5 LPA, so that was the scenario of placement in ABES. There is no such thing as so-called college life in this college, you are given opportunities, but that too will be limited overall decent college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is decent, labs are good its just the college is overcrowded, and the ratio of people to lab computers is not that good, so its very important thing. Overall, the campus is good, including 3 canteens, which are decent, you can say, and the ground is good, but you have to be an active participant to play any of the sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the course structure and faculty. The teachers are really passionate.

content.Placements: I'm in 2nd year currently. As much as I have seen, the placements are decided by the amount of hard work you do. Although college does bring companies for placement, and atleast 60% of the students get placed easily with an average package of 6-7 LPA. I think they can definitely do better.
content.Infrastructure: Each classroom has projectors along with 150 GB of data provided to each student monthly. The air conditioned don't work sometimes, other than that the infrastructure is average. There are no particular systems for students that work very efficiently. Some staff (not teachers) are very rude and behave unprofessionally. As this college has dress, the dress vendors are very professional, although the quality of the dress is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My review of college life.

content.Placements: So there is a decent place in our college. About 70% of the students get placed, and the average package is 4-5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Infosys, Accenture, TCS, etc. So the highest package is currently 32 LPA, and the lowest is about 3.2 LPA. There are opportunities for internships, but it totally depends on your skill level, and girls get more opportunities than boys. SDE, testing, and software developer are the top roles provided.
content.Infrastructure: So, the infrastructure is quite decent here, and the campus is not that green, but beautiful and lush green. Wi-Fi is available in every block as well as AC's and a water purifier. Well, there are a huge number of opportunities for games and sports here, but medical facilities are not that auspicious. The mess food is very average, as well as the canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A decent college with high fees.

content.Placements: A decent placement ratio is there, but only a few ones get good offers on campus. You may get good offers off campus if you are skilled enough. Top recruitment are only mass recruiters like TCS or Cognizant. The average is around 4 LPA. The highest on campus this time is 12 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: An above-average infrastructure with WVG. Classrooms all have AC, but college Wi-Fi is good. The hostel mess food is really bad, but that is the same for all private colleges. Rooms are decent, and you get attached washrooms. There is a medical store in it.

admission_overview.college_name: ABES Engineering College Course Admissions: Fees, Eligibility, Dates & Selection Process

paragraphs: ABES Engineering College admissions 2024are offered for various courses at UG and PG levels. The college offers only one undergraduate programme, i.e.,BTechin eight different specialisations. There are three postgraduate programmes, namelyMCA, MBA, and MTech. The college also offers lateral entry admission to the BTech programme.ABES Engineering Collegeadmission to all theUG and PG coursesis entirely entrance-based. Candidates not having any valid entrance exam score can also avail of admission through the Management quota.

ABES Engineering College admission to each programme is done through two modes:counselling andManagement quota. 85% of the total seats are filled through counselling based on respective entrance exam scores. Whereas, the remaining 15% of seats are filled through direct admissions.

ABES Engineering College admissions are only entrance-based for all courses. Candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the courses they desire to apply.Below are the eligibility criteria along with the ABES Engineering College accepted entrance exams related to ABESEC course admissions:
Eligibility
- Class 12 with minimum 45% aggregate in the respective subjects
- Pass DVoc in the same disciplines
Counselling-based:JEE Main+UPTAC Counselling(85% seats)
Direct:Valid JEE Main Score + Institute-level Test + PI (15% seats)
Pass two/three-year Diploma with minimum 45% aggregate
- Obtain minimum 45% aggregate in UG degree of BSc
Counselling-based:CUET UG+ UPTAC Counselling (10% seats) or
Direct:Valid CUET score Institute-level Test + PI (15% seats)
Passed Bachelor’s degree of at least 3 years duration with minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category)
BCA/ bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent degree with minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category)
BSc/ BCom/ BA with Mathematics at Class 12 or at graduation (with additional bridge courses) with a minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category)
Counselling-based:CUET PG + UPTAC Counselling (85% seats)
Direct:Valid CUET Score + Institute-level Test + PI (15% seats)
BE/ BTech in relevant specialisation with a minimum 50% aggregate or equivalent CGPA for General & OBC candidates (45% for SC/ ST)
CheckABES Engineering College Fee Structure

The different components included in ABESEC fees are tuition fee, security deposit, hostel fee, mess fee, etc. Candidates shall be able to pay the fee annually or semester-wise. The one-time charges, such as library security deposit, institute security deposit, grade card, and more have to be paid once at the time of admission. Along with that, the total seat intake may also vary depending upon the course and specialisations. Candidates willing to apply for admission UG & PG courses at ABESEC must fill an online application form on the official website of the college. The application mode is completely online. Interested students can register fo their desired course after fulfilling the basic educational requirements of the course.
ABESEC selects students through entrance and counselling process. Apart from that, direct admission is also offered through a specific selection criteria. Find below the detailed steps:

faqs.question: How can candidates join ABES Engineering College?
faqs.answer: ABES Engineering College is located in Ghaziabad. It is approved by the University Grant Commission of India and accredited as "B" grade by NAAC . According to the NIRF 2023 Rankings, it holds a position in the Top 250 Universities and colleges of India.If candidates want to join ABES college, they must fulfil basic criteria that demand programmes like BTech, and students must give an exam called JEE Main with 60 percent aggregate marks in Class 12.For MCA, candidates must take the CUET exam and for an MBA, they must have an undergraduate degree from well-known university.Go to their official website and check whether you are eligible or not and now fill out the admission form and pay the fee. Once admitted, the selected students will receive an email.

faqs.question: What is the procedure to take BTech admission at ABES Engineering College?
faqs.answer: ABES Engineering College provides both undergraduate and postgraduate courses in different streams like Science and commerce, and offers different courses like B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA and MCA. The admission procedure varies based on course, for B.Tech admission JEE Main exam is accepted then you can apply for admission to the college, the institute will shortlist students based on their PCM scores in the Class 12 board and JEE Main score, thereafter candidates will be called for interview and test.

The mess food and canteen are also good, though the canteen is a little bit expensive, but it is still good, and the mess food is also not that bad. So, in all we can say that the mess food and canteen service are good.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good, or we can say decent, college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is decent, labs are good its just the college is overcrowded, and the ratio of people to lab computers is not that good, so its very important thing. Overall, the campus is good, including 3 canteens, which are decent, you can say, and the ground is good, but you have to be an active participant to play any of the sports.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the course structure and faculty. The teachers are really passionate.
reviews.review_text: Each classroom has projectors along with 150 GB of data provided to each student monthly. The air conditioned don't work sometimes, other than that the infrastructure is average. There are no particular systems for students that work very efficiently. Some staff (not teachers) are very rude and behave unprofessionally. As this college has dress, the dress vendors are very professional, although the quality of the dress is good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of college life.
reviews.review_text: So, the infrastructure is quite decent here, and the campus is not that green, but beautiful and lush green. Wi-Fi is available in every block as well as AC's and a water purifier. Well, there are a huge number of opportunities for games and sports here, but medical facilities are not that auspicious. The mess food is very average, as well as the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college with high fees.
reviews.review_text: An above-average infrastructure with WVG. Classrooms all have AC, but college Wi-Fi is good. The hostel mess food is really bad, but that is the same for all private colleges. Rooms are decent, and you get attached washrooms. There is a medical store in it.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money and placement in AKTU University.
reviews.review_text: For facilities, this college is perfect for you because it provides the best infrastructure that a private college should have, like fully furnished AC classrooms and 24*7 .Wi-Fi facility in the hostel and college as well. There are a total of 3 large canteens where you find a decent taste. Overall, I would rate it 5 star in terms of infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Very little hope from college.
reviews.review_text: Everything is well and good. They are not supportive other than academics. They are not providing anything like bats, and when the football team wants to practice, they also switch off the lights. Additionally, they offer their cricket ground to corporations for money, which is a bad thing.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good in academics, and teachers are also caring.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and other facilities are also good in college. Many computer labs are there in college, and library is also good. The college provides excellent, modern infrastructure with smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a huge library that creates a great learning environment. The entire campus has reliable Wi-Fi connectivity, and all necessary equipment is available and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college because it has a good placement record for many years.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and the infrastructure of the college are good. Every course/department provides a good Wi-Fi connection and a computer laptop for the betterment of the students. There is a central library also, which provides a good, peaceful environment for the students to concentrate on their studies.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college with everything just average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of this college is quite good, actually. I mean, Wi-Fi is present, not working everywhere, but it's there, and when in need, you can rely on it for educational purposes only. Every classroom has ACs, and the library is also good for studying. Hostels are just mid.

reviews.review_heading: A college that shaped my dreams with great faculty and higher education support.
reviews.review_text: I was not a hosteler, so I can't tell about hostels, but I was a day scholar, so it was quite good for canteens and medical facilities. I haven't faced any problem at all so far. The food is quite good, and the coffee is quite fresh. I really liked the behaviour of the canteen staff, as they were very kind. Even when I visit sometimes, they also like it a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and remember college.
reviews.review_text: ABES is noted for its good infrastructure, which includes AC classrooms, projectors in every class, a central library, and 24/7 Wi-Fi, as well as various food courts and parking facilities. The college offers a fun campus life with frequent events and a supportive environment with no ragging. There is a strong emphasis on building discipline and multitasking skills.

reviews.review_heading: ABES is absolutely good because of its good placement records and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of ABES is good. It provides all facilities like AC in all the classrooms as well as in the hostels. Wi-Fi is also available in the college as well as in the hostel with a good internet connection. Mess, canteens, and medical facilities are also provided in the college and hostel too.

reviews.review_heading: ABES is good because of its faculty and good placement records.
reviews.review_text: All kinds of facilities are available in the college campus as well as in the hostels. In every class, AC is available. Wi-Fi is also available. A central library is also available in the college for the students, which provides a peaceful environment. Medical facilities are also available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and hostel facilities at ABES Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The CSE department at ABES has modern infrastructure. It has smart classrooms, high speed Wi-Fi, and advanced computer labs with the latest systems and software. The library offers digital resources and quiet study. Hostels are clean, Wi-Fi-enabled, and secure with 24/7 surveillance, laundry, and power backup. The mess provides hygienic food. Canteen offers multiple meal options. Medical facilities with a resident doctor and sports facilities like a gym, football, and cricket grounds are availab...

faqs.answer: At its Delhi NCR Campus, Christ (demeed-to-be) University offers full-time BCom in various specialisations. Admission to the course is subject to the fulfilment of the course-specific eligibility criteria prescribed by the university. The common eligibility criteria for BCom admission at Christ Delhi NCR is for candidates to have passed Class 12. The university has also specified the minimum aggregate requirement for some specialisations. However, having studied Maths in Class 12 is not compulsory for BCom admission as per the specified eligibility criteria.
faqs.question: Q: Is Maths compulsory for BCom admission at Christ Delhi NCR?

faqs.answer: The requirements for admission to Christ University vary depending on the course. The CUET exam, a micro presentation, and a personal interview are nevertheless requirements for the majority of courses. A 10+2 Diploma from a recognised board is required for those pursuing a BBA.An admission to Christ University's numerous campuses is provided by the online CUET. For the aforementioned programs, all of Christ University's campuses—both on and off—accept the results of the Common Entrance Test (CUET).
faqs.question: Q: What is the admission process of Christ Delhi NCR?

faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to Christ Delhi are first of all required meet the eligibility criteria and check out the selection criteria of their desired course and then fill out the application form through the Christ Delhi official website. After filling out the application form, applicants are required to appear for the relevant entrance exam. For most of the UG and PG course admission, the University conductes Christ University Entrance Test (CUET). Candidates seeking admission to the flagship MBA course are required to appear for MAT / CAT / CMAT / XAT / GMAT / GRE / ATMA entrance exams.The University will shortlist candidates based on entrance exam scores. Selected candidates will receive and E-offer admission which will be valid upto the date mentioned in the letter.Shortlisted candidates are required to appear for the document verification process and pay the admission registraton fee to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Christ Delhi?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission toChrist Delhiare first of all required meet the eligibility criteria and check out the selection criteria of their desired course and then fill out the application form through the Christ Delhi official website.After filling out the application form, applicants are required to appear for the relevant entrance exam. For most of the UG and PG course admission, the University conductesChrist University Entrance Test (CUET).Candidates seeking admission to the flagship MBA course are required to appear forMAT / CAT / CMAT / XAT / GMAT / GRE / ATMAentrance exams.The University will shortlist candidates based on entrance exam scores. faqs.question: Are admissions at Christ Delhi NCR entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Christ Delhi NCR admissions are both entrance and merit-based. The institute accepts students to majority of its programmes on the basis of valid score secured by the candidates in either national-level entrance test or university's own entrance test; CUET (Christ University Entrance Test). Additonally, for a few other courses such as MSc, PG Diploma, etc, the institute accepts students on a merit basis. For further information, candidates can visit the official website of the institute.

faqs.question: Is Maths compulsory for BCom admission at Christ Delhi NCR?
faqs.answer: At its Delhi NCR Campus, Christ (demeed-to-be) University offers full-time BCom in various specialisations. Admission to the course is subject to the fulfilment of the course-specific eligibility criteria prescribed by the university. The common eligibility criteria for BCom admission at Christ Delhi NCR is for candidates to have passed Class 12. The university has also specified the minimum aggregate requirement for some specialisations. However, having studied Maths in Class 12 is not compulsory for BCom admission as per the specified eligibility criteria.

paragraphs: TechnoIndia University Kolkataadmissions 2026 are both merit and entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed process aroundTechnoIndia Universityadmissions 2026:
Step 1:TechnoIndia UniversityApplication Process

TechnoIndia Universityadmission process 2026 starts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department atTechnoIndia University. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG courses atTechnoIndia Universityis entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such as CAT, MAT for the selection of respective courses. Furthermore, the university offers UG courses through its affiliated colleges. Admissions to UG courses are based on merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

placement_data.title: Techno India University Kolkata Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: Techno India University Kolkata placement cell is well-equipped and facilitates all types of placement-related activities. The placement office at the University not only acts as a bridge between students and the industry but also conducts career-related training programs . The Techno India University placement process starts every year in the month of September and continues till July next year.

Industrial training is also provided by the University. Students undertake the summer training during their second or third of study whereas Techno India University Kolkata conducts the winter training program for students who cannot pursue the summer the training program. Internships are provided in top MNCs and students visit countries such as China and Germany for internships. Other than this, training programs are conducted in France and USA .
The University has facilitated the placement process for more than 5 lakh alumni till now. The salary package of most of the alumni of Techno India University is above INR 12 LPA .

reviews.review_text: The college has a small campus. It is neat, clean, and looks very beautiful. All facilities essential for studies are available, like a library, computer labs, and Wi-Fi. The college doesn't have its own hostel. PGs or flats are available near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing experience; best faculty.
reviews.review_text: Courses are highly curriculum-related. Classrooms are spacious and clean for us to spread our sheets and start drawing. There is a strong Wi-Fi connection. The only complaint is that it would be better to have a medical room with some supplies of first-aid, some electrolytes, and paracetamol in college, and even just a place to go and take some rest when we are feeling unwell. reviews.review_heading: Absolutely, Techno India Universities are a secret college to take admission in.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the college named Techno India University.
reviews.review_text: The college does not provide a hostel. You have to look for your accommodation on your own. The infrastructure of the college is very good. All the classrooms and toilets/washrooms are being cleaned regularly. All the labs, halls, and classrooms are air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: It provides a formal quality of education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is quite decent for the money they are charging. I am unable to tell about the PG situation as I am a day scholar. The campus is well-maintained. Toilets are cleaned twice daily, so there is no such problem in this case.

reviews.review_heading: It has decent infrastructure and placements.

reviews.review_heading: It is good but their placement is very few.

reviews.review_heading: Techno is one of the top private colleges in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is top-notch as it provides fully air conditioned classrooms with neat and clean benches. Even corridors also have ACs. reviews.review_heading: The college has a peaceful and best environment.
reviews.review_text: The facilities include Wi-Fi access, good seating arrangements, and clean washrooms. There are hygiene standards for girls. Classrooms are well-maintained, and the library is also in excellent condition. In the canteen, healthy snacks and meals are offered at reasonable prices. Medical facilities are available. The sports department regularly organizes games and activities.

reviews.review_heading: It has a strong technical foundation with decent placements and growing infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: As a 2nd-year student of B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Techno India University, Kolkata, I have experienced a good range of facilities that support academic and overall development. Our department is equipped with essential labs such as the analog electronics lab, digital electronics lab, communication systems lab, microprocessor and microcontroller lab, and VLSI and embedded systems labs.

reviews.review_heading: About Techno India University and the program of B.Sc. in media science.
reviews.review_text: Techno India has moreover good helpful and reputed faculty members, who help their students with almost everything and at every path. review_content.Placements: The placement chances for the B.Sc. Biotechnology degree at IMS Ghaziabad, where I studied, fell short of expectations. The majority of the available positions were in sales and marketing and had little to do with the biotechnology industry. However, given the ability levels, the compensation amount was fair. Most pupils decided to continue their education. Despite this disadvantage, the opportunities were comparatively better than those offered by other universities offering a B.Sc. In biotechnology.
review_content.Infrastructure: There isn't much open space on the IMS Ghaziabad campus, and there isn't much ground. The facilities at the canteen are not particularly impressive, and many think they are rather pricey. There aren't many extracurricular activities, and there aren't many events planned all year long. Nonetheless, the freshmen parties and annual fests are entertaining and well-planned, bringing some energy to campus life. On the plus side, the campus has first-rate Wi-Fi and air conditioning, which guarantee that students are comfortable and connected.

The institute gives a rigorous, complete, and exercise-orientated PGDM path accredited by way of AICTE, equal to an MBA. The curriculum is designed to satisfy enterprise needs, with a focal point on sensible getting to know thru internships and industry interactions. IMS Ghaziabad additionally affords scholarships primarily based on academic performance. Overall, IMS Ghaziabad is thought for its best education, experienced school, and strong placement possibilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My Experience as a B.Sc. Biotech Student: The Good & The Challenges.

content.Placements: I am a B.Sc. A biotechnology student, and in our course, around 55-60% of students get placed, mostly in labs, hospitals, and research support companies. The highest package is usually around 5-6 LPA, the lowest around 1.8 LPA, and the average stays near 2.5-3 LPA. Companies like Biocon, Cipla, and local research labs visit for hiring and internships. About half of the students also get internships in hospitals, diagnostic labs, and biotech startups. The top roles include lab technician, quality control trainee, research assistant, and clinical intern. Placements are decent if you are genuinely interested in lab work and research.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelors in Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of IMS Ghaziabad University Courses Campus

content.Placements: I am a BCA student, and placements in our course are fairly good. Around 70–75% of students get placed, with the highest package around 8–9 LPA and an average of 3–4 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and Capgemini visit each year. Many of us also get internships in IT firms and startups, which help in gaining real experience. Most roles offered are developer trainee, support engineer, QA intern, and web assistant.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus is clean and well-maintained. It includes good labs, Wi-Fi, projectors, and a peaceful library. As a female student, I find the hostel environment safe and comfortable. Rooms are clean. Security is strict, and basic needs are taken care of. The mess food is simple but decent. The canteen offers better snack options. Medical help and sports facilities are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Decent college, but, bad ROI.

content.Placements: The placement chances for the B.Sc. Biotechnology degree at IMS Ghaziabad, where I studied, fell short of expectations. The majority of the available positions were in sales and marketing and had little to do with the biotechnology industry. However, given the ability levels, the compensation amount was fair. Most pupils decided to continue their education. Despite this disadvantage, the opportunities were comparatively better than those offered by other universities offering a B.Sc. In biotechnology.
content.Infrastructure: There isn't much open space on the IMS Ghaziabad campus, and there isn't much ground. The facilities at the canteen are not particularly impressive, and many think they are rather pricey. There aren't many extracurricular activities, and there aren't many events planned all year long. Nonetheless, the freshmen parties and annual fests are entertaining and well-planned, bringing some energy to campus life. On the plus side, the campus has first-rate Wi-Fi and air conditioning, which guarantee that students are comfortable and connected.

review_summary.college_name: Vishwakarma University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The worst college I have seen.

content.Placements: Our college has no good placements. There are not many companies like other colleges. The companies that are coming are not giving too much package. This companies give only 3 LPA to 4 LPA packages. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the average is not known to us.
content.Infrastructure: Our college doesn't have any hostel and because of this, we have to take a private hostel which is far from college. The area is also not good but college has AC. All facilities are there for students, and the college campus is small and there is much crowd.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, friends, teachers, and seniors.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placed in college. The highest salary package offered is 30 LPA and the minimum is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are JP Morgan, Amazon, and Flipkart. More than 50% of students get placements based on skills in our course. B.Tech CSE is top course.
content.Infrastructure: My college has a Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Our library has all the books that are required for engineering and our library staff is supportive. I am living in the flat and my canteen is good to eat. There is a basketball ground with sports games like cricket and tennis.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has the top infrastructure in Pune and guaranteed internships. Job placements depend on skills.

content.Placements: Internships are guaranteed, with many getting placed at TCS and some at Wipro. Jobs depend on skills and not CGPA. Teachers help deserving students secure great opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: We cannot complain about the infrastructure at all especially labs. The college boasts top-tier infrastructure, better than 90% of Pune colleges. There is a friendly environment. There are about 5 canteens and a food lane called a hotspot. The food can be a lot better but there are cold drinks. There is a variety of food and also expensive snacks. I bought a mojito for Rs. 100.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent campus life and industry-focused curriculum at VU.

content.Placements: The percentage placement of VU, Pune is excellent. The highest package reaches 51 LPA, with average packages being 9 LPA-10 LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, TCS, Barclays, and Deloitte. The highest stipend for the internship in CSE is 3-7 Lakhs/month. Popular roles include software engineering, data analyst, consultant, and product specials. Mechanical, IT, ETC, and chemical have the best placements. It has good placement with companies like Mercedes Bens, Accenture, and Wipro.
content.Infrastructure: VU, Pune has good infrastructure and Wi-Fi enabled campus, well-equipped labs, good classrooms, and library with vast academic resources. Hostels provide modern amenities with separate accommodation for boys and girls, though opinions on mess food vary on quality. Medical facilities include on-campus medical rooms with doctors. Sports and recreation are encouraged with facilities for various games and modern gymnasium.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Vishwakarma: A disaster.

content.Placements: Students are given admission regardless of any percentage criteria. It's just that you have to give any one of the exams, like JEE, CET, or the college entrance exam, and regardless of the score, they give you admission. The highest is 10-13 Lacs and the lowest is around 3-4 Lacs. Placements of VU happen with VIT, and the only requirement is a good (around 9) CGPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the hostel is great for the girls' hostel. The mess is nice, hygienic, and overall it's great in terms of the hostel, but the infrastructure for the course is not even average. Everything is under construction, even the playgrounds. Although they have made Wi-Fi, labs, and a library available, in terms of rating, it's really very average. Not good.

reviews.review_heading: The worst college I have seen.
reviews.review_text: Our college doesn't have any hostel and because of this, we have to take a private hostel which is far from college. The area is also not good but college has AC. All facilities are there for students, and the college campus is small and there is much crowd.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, friends, teachers, and seniors.
reviews.review_text: My college has a Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Our library has all the books that are required for engineering and our library staff is supportive. I am living in the flat and my canteen is good to eat. There is a basketball ground with sports games like cricket and tennis.

reviews.review_heading: It has the top infrastructure in Pune and guaranteed internships. Job placements depend on skills.
reviews.review_text: We cannot complain about the infrastructure at all especially labs. The college boasts top-tier infrastructure, better than 90% of Pune colleges. There is a friendly environment. There are about 5 canteens and a food lane called a hotspot. The food can be a lot better but there are cold drinks. There is a variety of food and also expensive snacks. I bought a mojito for Rs. 100.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus life and industry-focused curriculum at VU.
reviews.review_text: VU, Pune has good infrastructure and Wi-Fi enabled campus, well-equipped labs, good classrooms, and library with vast academic resources. Hostels provide modern amenities with separate accommodation for boys and girls, though opinions on mess food vary on quality. Medical facilities include on-campus medical rooms with doctors. Sports and recreation are encouraged with facilities for various games and modern gymnasium.

reviews.review_heading: Vishwakarma: A disaster.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is great for the girls' hostel. The mess is nice, hygienic, and overall it's great in terms of the hostel, but the infrastructure for the course is not even average. Everything is under construction, even the playgrounds. Although they have made Wi-Fi, labs, and a library available, in terms of rating, it's really very average. Not good.

reviews.review_heading: Not that much satisfied with this university.
reviews.review_text: So, according to me, the infrastructure of our college is not good, meaning it's not developed properly. Hence, they are working on it, but it might take some years to get built properly. The Wi-Fi availability is proper, the labs are good, the classrooms are not proper, and the library is also good. The hostel of the university is so bad, meaning no Wi-Fi and the mess is the worst. How can someone manage to eat that food?

reviews.review_heading: College is fantastic and gives best experience.
reviews.review_text: The labs and classrooms are amazing. The food quality of the hostel is amazing, and the medical facility is good. They have lots of sports activities, and the clubs and curriculum activities give students on-ground experience.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing teachers and really good infrastructures.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very kind and eager to teach us. They make sure we learn something new every day and encourage us to explore new concepts. The classrooms are tidy and clean. In the design department, they have a library, workshops, a photography room, an art and design room, and computer labs. Both the hostels and the college provide high-speed Wi-Fi. The food is great in the hostel, and we have laundry days so we don't have to wash clothes by hand. The canteen in VU is really affordable for ...

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and infrastructure are available for students at the Vishwakarma University.
reviews.review_text: Vishwakarma University has a well-maintained and developed infrastructure for the M.Sc. course. All kinds of necessary facilities are available for students. Library and Wi-Fi facilities are available for students on the college campus. Hostel facilities are also available for students. Sports and other necessary facilities are provided to students.

reviews.review_heading: College have great infrastructure but very poor placement.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, parking, canteens, AC classrooms, etc. Huge buildings, great infrastructure, clean toilets. Food quality in the hostel depends on the canteen. There are 3 main canteens in VU. Overall, quality is good but not great. Sports are there.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the management and faculty of Vishwakarma University.
reviews.review_text:
Vishwakarma University is having a lively campus. Facilities available on the campus of the college are good. All the necessary facilities, such as labs, WiFi, libraries, canteens, etc., for the students. Infrastructure for computer science is also good. 
Sports facilities are also given to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vishwakarma University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty much simple and you can also use the wifi of the college on campus. The library is a bit smaller, as it has only 26-28k books, which is again a minus point but soon there will be more options to explore. The canteen is really good and a bit hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Best of Vishwakarma University
reviews.review_text: All the departments have good ventilated classrooms with enough lighting. Some departments also have air-conditioned classrooms. They have smart boards and blackboards. There are many labs and even Wi-Fi. They have huge libraries and also many reading rooms and study rooms for self-study. The hostel has good and hygienic food. The environment is also hygienic and clean, with good stay services. Canteens and mess are provided, including medical facilities and grounds for sports.

reviews.review_heading: B.Sc. [Hons] Computer Science.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the college. Labs are well cleaned and well maintained, with all the lab accessories working. Classrooms are also well maintained and cleaned, and the library provides good facilities along with nice behavior from the faculty.

reviews.review_heading: Vishwakarma university, whetherel to take admission.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not on par for a private college. B.Teach course doesn't have much of a campus life the buildings are old and under construction, also they don't give priority to infrastructure more than the placements. So don't opt this college for campus life.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with campus and faculty, good placements, and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Gitam offers Wi-Fi enabled classrooms known as smart classrooms. Classrooms, well equipped labs, and a central library with digital resources. Hostels are comfortable with Wi-Fi, the mess provides decent food, canteens add variety, and facilities include medical care.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the college and would highly recommend it.
reviews.review_text: We have the best infrastructure, and our library has an investment of 200 crores. We have campuses all over the university. The food here is amazing, and we have many sports grounds. We even have an ambulance when needed. We have AC classrooms, and the hostel infrastructure is amazing, with good food and many vending machines.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing campus with very good faculty and executive environment.
reviews.review_text: We have a good Wi-Fi connection on our campus. We also have the best AC classrooms. The hostel infrastructure is just amazing top-quality food and rooms are provided in our hostel. We even have vending machines where you can quickly grab your snacks. Every classroom has a CC camera. The food in the college canteen is amazing, and we even have 3 cafes in the college. You can try almost all varieties of food. We have grounds for basketball, volleyball, football, table tennis, cricket, badminton, a...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure of the college is very good and clean.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are Wi-Fi, practical labs, Bloomberg labs, library, classroom, auditorium, canteen, cafe, and sports ground, and indoor games. In the hostel, the quality of food is very good. The hostels are very well-maintained, and the food is very delicious. There are 3 canteens and 3 cafes on the campus. There is also a sick room for medical emergencies. The sports facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Gitam : overall a good experience for BBA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent; most of the students join the college seeing the extravagant campus; it is thoroughly cleaned and well maintained; even the feedback form is circulated for thorough reviews; sports facilities are so good here; food is good too; a variety of options; medical facilities are fine, but response is late .

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely grateful for the support from college teachers and hostel wardens.
reviews.review_text: In Gitam, there are many facilities and students who know how to use them perfectly find it very useful because the infrastructure is really good and the facilities are good. In the hostel, the food provided is also very tasty and healthy. In college, the canteen food is also outstanding, and there are many sports and games to play and participate in.

reviews.review_heading: Gitam university is best college in Hyderabad as per my suggestion.
reviews.review_text: As compared to other colleges the fee of hostel a quite high, the quality of the food is good and there are variety of food providing every day, weekly two times they provide veg and non veg. There are indoor for students in hostel they can play ant anytime, accessories are provided by hostel.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities. The infrastructure of our college is good. It provides good internet connectivity in each classroom. The canteen facilities are good. The quality of the food is good. The hostel facilities are good. The hostel provides good indoor games. It provides good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our college are good. The infrastructure is satisfying. There are several labs, digital classrooms, and indoor game areas present on our campus. There is a vast library over here. Five canteens are presently located on the campus. Medical rooms are also arranged.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GITAM School of Business, Hyderabad.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of the college are good enough. The Wi-Fi is good and labs are well maintained. Classrooms and the library are also good. Wi-Fi is not available in classrooms. The hostel and food are not good. The hostel fee is very high. It is not worth the money.

reviews.review_heading: GITAM has the best university life
reviews.review_text: The college provides good facilities on campus, and the faculty, and infrastructure are awesome. All the food provided is hygienic and healthy. The infrastructure is awesome. Space needs to be provided. The college is very peaceful as well as hygienic. The hostel rooms are hygienic and the campus is green.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure facilities were not that much good when we were doing MBA. We expect more professional experience, but there was nothing like that. There was only one lab and one library for all the departments. The classrooms were very small. The only thing good in Gitam is the canteen. We have 4 canteens that provide good food.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied to be a part of this college.
reviews.review_text: I got placed in Deloitte as an analyst. It is an institution that believes in developing students first, enhance their skills and make them placements-ready. About 30 companies visited here. The highest salary package offered is around 8 LPA, and the average salary package offered is about 4 LPA.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with it, and I am proud of being a GITAMite.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on our campus, and we have study labs, a British library, smart classrooms, three canteens to hang out, a subway, and a medical room with a medical team. Indoor sports room, outdoor grounds, and all the equipment are available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I am satisfied with the placements provided.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good-looking and well arranged. Every MBA classroom has central AC. The library is excellent with lots of books. The food in canteens and mess is completely hygienic. We have 3 sports hours a week. The hostels are quite good.

paragraphs: City Group of Colleges admission 2025is open for all courses. The College offers various courses at the UG and PG levels through its twelve constituent colleges.City Group of Collegesis affiliated withAKTU,DR. Ram Manohar Lohia Avadh UniversityandUniversity of Lucknow. The flagship programmes offered at City Group of College include LLB, BCA, BBA and MBA, among others. Admission to all City Group of Colleges courses is merit-based. Candidates willing to apply can either apply online through the official website of the College or visit the college campus with relevant documents for registration.

To get admission to any of the CGC courses, candidates must fulfil the basic eligibility requirements. The selection criteria for all courses is merit-based. Tabulated below are some of the course-wise eligibility & selection criteria for CGC course admission 2025:
Make your course selection here, to check the eligibility and selection criteria for all City Group of Colleges courses.

City Group of Colleges admission process is a multi-step process that begins with the release of application forms. The CGC application forms are released online on the official website as well as offline. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria of their desired course must apply to the course before the deadline. Check the steps below to read about the City Group of College admission process in detail:

reviews.review_heading: City Group of College is a good college in Lucknow and has good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Best college with best educated teachers and high rate of placement.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by City Law College, City Group of CollegesReviewed on 16 Oct 2024)
reviews.review_heading: If you want to become a judge then you can join City law College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. Hostel facilities are available only for girls, but the college is working on providing hostel facilities for boys as well. Canteen facilities are available, but medical and sports facilities are lacking.

reviews.review_heading: Strong industry connections and excellent placements with room for curriculum improvement.
reviews.review_text: City Group of Colleges offers modern facilities like high-speed Wi-Fi, proper smart classrooms, well-structured labs, and a vast library. Hostels are comfortable and provide many amenities, including proper mess food, cleanliness, and a canteen that offers snacks. On-campus medical facilities are also available, along with sports and physical activities like a gym and various game courts.

reviews.review_heading: Teachers are very nice and supportive.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good; all the classrooms are air-conditioned, and library facilities are provided at a very low cost. All the classes have smart classrooms, and there is a courtroom for practicing. The faculty members are nice and very supportive.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides good education but it lacks in placements.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in the college campus are good and the classrooms are well maintained. There are ACs. Classrooms with sanitized chairs are there. Food in the canteen is not so good. In the name of sports, there is a basketball court. Here you can find a big library.

reviews.review_heading: City college - the worst college in whole city.
reviews.review_text: They don't have hostel facilities or connected linked hostels. The labs, classrooms, etc. were more than good. There is a school canteen with basic stuff available at market rate. There is not much focus or space available for ground since our campus is too limited in space. We hardly see any activity or involvement of students in sports.

paragraphs: School of Management, CMR University admissionsare primarily entrance-based. The school under CMR University considers scores in national or state-level entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, KMAT, etc. for admission to the specific programme. Besides,CMR UniversityconductsCMRUATfor admission to various UG and PG courses.SOM, CMR Universityoffers BBA/ BBA (Hons) at UG and MBA & Executive MBA at the PG levels. Interested candidates can apply online for the preferred programme.

School of Management under CMR University offers courses at UG and PG levels in full-time mode. Candidates need to appear for CMRUAT conducted by the university for admission. The school also accepts other entrance exam scores for admission. Below areSOM CMR University coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Bachelor's degree of a minimum of three-years with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for SC/ ST/ PwD)
A minimum of 3 years post qualification managerial /executive/ supervisory work experience in industry / educational institutions is a mandate

School of Management admissions are currently open for all the programmes. Candidates must first register to participate in the selection rounds. Below are the steps to get a seat in SOM CMR University:
Step 1: SOM CMR University Application Process 2025

Eligible aspirants can apply online for the preferred course. Candidates must fill out the personal, academic and contact details in the application form. Aspirants also need to pay an application fee to register for admission.
Step 2: Selection

The school shortlists candidates based on CMRUAT scores for admission to BBA (Hons) and MBA programmes. Besides, aspirants with a valid score in CAT,MAT, CMAT,KMAT, etc. can also get admission in MBA programme. Further, selection for Executive MBA is based on merit of the aspirants in the qualifying exam. Aspirants must also hold a minimum of three-years work experience for admission in EMBA.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Once the selection process is over, the School of Management sends an offer letter to the aspirants. Selected candidates further need to pay theSOM CMR University feeto confirm their seat.

paragraphs: Students can follow the below steps for KSRM admissions:
1: Application Process
Students can visit the official website and apply for the preferred course. Students can appear for CAT/XAT/CMAT/MAT and register directly on the KSRM official website.

Admissions are entrance-based for MBA courses. The exam is conducted in the online mode across 15 cities in India. Candidates who have passed any other national-level entrance exams, including CAT, XAT or MAT are also eligible for admission.
3: Result Declaration & Selection

4: Admission Confirmation
After the completion of all the rounds, students are provided final admission. Students can report to the campus with their documents, and pay the application fee.

reviews.review_heading: The college insight and MBA experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. It has excellent Wi-Fi connectivity, high-tech classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a comprehensive library. The food in the canteen is very affordable and of good quality. Sports facilities and recreational areas are available.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good for MBA students.
reviews.review_text: The infra of the college is poor. Classrooms are good. There is no hostel but the college has tied up with PGs. Canteen facility is there in the campus, similar to a mess. Food is okay.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for those who want to do programs like CA/CS.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not at good. There is no campus of the college, we have only one building. While studying, we feel like we are studying in some coaching institute. Hostel is also not good and the hostel in-charge is not a good person. He wants only money. Services provide by the hostel are not appropriate. The food quality is the worst and there are no sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is amazingly perfect for MBA.
reviews.review_text: There are no unnecessary things in our university. Our college had perfectly enough infrastructure which is necessary for students like a good library, canteen, study hall, Wi-Fi, computer lab, etc. I did not stay in the hostel, so I don't know about it.

All your classes will fulfilled with all amenities like AC, good lighting, projection, dedicated chairs for individual will feel a friendly environment around you.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty but infrastructure was not up to the mark.
